records.name: Quiver GTM
records.tagline: Run developer marketing like an engineering system
records.description: Quiver is an agentic developer marketing system for technical founders and dev-tool teams. It keeps product context, customer evidence, campaigns, content, tasks and results connected in one controlled system. Unlike another AI writing tool, Quiver gives agents durable context, version history, explicit production states, a Content API, MCP access and a human-approved feedback loop. Use hosted Quiver with managed team access and built-in tasks, or self-host the free MIT-licensed edition.

records.name: PixVerse R2
records.tagline: A real-time world model you can explore and change
records.description: PixVerse R2 is a real-time world model that generates continuously evolving audiovisual worlds instead of fixed video clips. It accepts text, images, audio and actions while generating, remembers what happened earlier in the session, and carries those changes forward in real time. R2 scales to longer, more coherent and controllable experiences — powering everything from interactive stories and characters to playable generative worlds.

records.name: 10xJoy
records.tagline: Discover desired outcomes + connect w/ builders who can help
records.description: Meet Joy, your free AI business matchmaker. Turn business goals into an editable brief without knowing what to build. Our early beta is welcoming its first builders. You choose what to share; introductions are coordinated by email. Builder work is scoped and priced directly.

records.name: Bleetz Network
records.tagline: AI agent-to-agent VC fundraising & scouting network
records.description: Fundraising is broken. Founders spend weeks searching for VCs, researching investment theses, checking sectors, stages and geographies, and sending cold emails, often without knowing who is actually a good fit. Bleetz Network automates the first part of this process. Your AI agent gets matched with 2,000+ SIMULATED agents of real VC, pitches the funds that fit your startup, and gets a YES, NO or MAYBE. A YES unlocks the fund’s contact details. Free, no strings attached.

records.name: Wand
records.tagline: Build software at the speed of thought
records.description: For builders who think faster than they type. The keyboard is becoming the bottleneck. Wand lets you think out loud instead of stopping to translate ideas into prompts. Ramble, react, change your mind mid-sentence - Wand keeps up and turns your thoughts into software. Welcome to the post-keyboard era.

records.name: LaterOn v2: The agentic email plaftform
records.tagline: Describe an email job once. Get sh*t done.
records.description: Please welcome LaterOn v2: a comprehensive email platform now capable of sending and receiving all types of emails. The platform comes with the agentic email workflows; simply describe an email task once, and the agent handles the execution—from monitoring relevant emails and replying with appropriate context to following up on non-responses and closing the conversation thread once your goal is achieved.

records.name: Basedash MCP write
records.tagline: Build charts and dashboards from Cursor and Claude
records.description: Basedash MCP can now write, not just read. From Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client, ask for a chart or a whole dashboard—Basedash explores the schema, writes and validates the SQL, picks the visualization, and lays it out. The result comes back as a real Basedash chart with a durable link and a rendered image, so you can keep iterating in the IDE or share it with the team. Edit it the same way: “break it out by plan” updates the live chart. Not just read. Write.

records.name: Kapshot
records.tagline: Screen recordings that look like you edited them
records.description: Kapshot is a screen recorder for people who need polished product demos, tutorials, and videos, without spending time editing them. Instead of recording your screen and then opening a video editor to add zooms, fix the cursor, and frame every interaction, Kapshot does the polish automatically while you record.

records.name: Kaiku
records.tagline: The task tracker your AI agents already know how to use
records.description: A task tracker and wiki built for teams whose work is increasingly done by AI agents. It speaks the API of the tracker most companies already run, so the MCP servers your agents use work unchanged. Built-in MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agents you call in a comment that propose but never decide, and every agent run's cost recorded on the issue it worked on.

records.name: FRCTL
records.tagline: Mind-Bending Media and Live Visuals
records.description: FRCTL is one engine for everything an artist ships and runs in the browser. Import your own footage or create generative shader scenes. Build a look, then pull cover art, a Spotify Canvas or a social clip. Run the loop live with direct full screen output. 190+ effects with infinite modulation and route audio into any parameter. Camera and canvas capture in live mode. Sell your presets or loops right in the Collective or post and comment on the member feed. Create, perform, monetize, collab.

records.name: Kairn
records.tagline: Turn any recorded convo into actionables and follow ups
records.description: Kairn turns conversations into the people, promises and next steps worth remembering. Capture a meeting—with everyone’s consent—or a quick thought. Review the people, tasks and dates Kairn finds, edit every detail, then save approved contacts, reminders and calendar events to your iPhone. Helpful AI, human control. Install the public TestFlight beta.

records.name: Promptic
records.tagline: Optimize GenAI applications for quality and cost
records.description: Promptic is the optimization platform for GenAI applications, better quality at lower cost. Benchmark models, tune prompts and agents, and optimize tool use against your own data and business metrics. Every candidate is scored on the quality and cost you actually care about, so you ship the configuration that wins instead of the one that sounded right. Runs wherever you are, dashboard UI, your CI, or your coding agent.

records.name: DemoScreen
records.tagline: Turn product screenshots into a narrated demo video
records.description: DemoScreen turns screenshots of your product into a finished demo video. Upload your screenshots, and it writes the script, adds a voiceover, background music and captions. Choose from five templates and three formats: 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. Narration is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French. Each video comes with an MP4 file, SRT captions, a GIF and a share link. A free plan is available.

records.name: World Signal
records.tagline: See where the world is behaving abnormally.
records.description: WORLD SIGNAL monitors real-world systems: earthquakes, wildfires, internet connectivity, aviation and more, to detect unusual activity across the planet. Explore anomalies, compare them with historical baselines, and investigate the evidence behind every signal.

records.name: Once UI 2.0
records.tagline: Builds consistent React apps for developers and AI agents
records.description: Once UI is an open-source design system for building polished React products with less repetitive code. Compose layouts with readable primitives, use a shared system of components and design tokens, and keep the result consistent as your product grows. Version 2.0 gives both you and your coding agent a clearer way to work. Its component catalog, compact rules, and task guides help agents use the system correctly; its foundations and predictable APIs make the output easier for you to understand.

records.name: Polyglot
records.tagline: Create and translate subtitles entirely on your Mac
records.description: Turn recordings into subtitles, translate SRT/VTT files, and export readable transcripts on your Mac. Polyglot keeps media and AI processing local, with editing, bilingual exports, batch translation, video enhancement and compression in one native app. Try unlimited transcription and translation for 7 days without an account. Pro is €29.99 once; editing, conversion, exports and video tools stay free. For Apple Silicon, macOS 14.4+.

records.name: Jango
records.tagline: Test multi-user apps with AI agents that act like real users
records.description: Jango lets you test the parts of your app that need more than one person. It gives your app a group of AI users, each with its own browser, account, goals and memory. Point Jango at your dev URL and watch them sign in and interact with each other in real time. Direct them, join in as yourself, or take control of any user's screen. At the end you get a report with actions, errors and screenshots. Use your own AI key or Jango's managed AI. Available on Mac.

records.name: Donna
records.tagline: Schedule multiple meetings with one link
records.description: Donna lets you combine a sequence of meetings into a single booking link. Instead of sending different links for every call, one link chains all meetings together with conditions like setting time gaps between meetings or keeping the next meeting locked until the previous one is completed. It also includes built-in workflows to prioritize important meetings, fill cancellations, route meetings across teams, and more.

records.name: COOLDOWN
records.tagline: A little pause before your next impulse purchase
records.description: Save what catches your eye, give it time, then decide. COOLDOWN turns shopping links into a personal cooling-off list, with editable product details, countdowns, widgets and optional reminders. Take a Second Look at your original reason before buying or letting go. Plus adds activity trials, purpose comparisons, temptation memory, Worth Keeping and Unbought Receipts. For iPhone. Your first five items are free; Plus offers unlimited new items.

records.name: Tellwe
records.tagline: Your coffee cup tells its story.
records.description: Upload a Turkish coffee cup. Tellwe finds the symbols in the grounds, writes a personal 45-second reading, and brings it to life through a character you can share. The name comes from “telve” the Turkish word for the coffee grounds left in the cup, where the fortune is traditionally read — reimagined as Tellwe: a cup with a story to tell.

records.name: Cutsio
records.tagline: One video asset library shared with your whole team
records.description: Still fiddling with large video files across Hard drives, Google drive links and dropbox folders? Cutsio is an AI native Video Media Asset Management Software that creates a single, shareable video library that your whole team can access with AI auto tagging, AI Summaries, Visual Intelligence, Intelligent content repurposing edits and handing off importable EDL & XML for Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve so that you still retain the human taste in your final edits

records.name: InfraGrid3D
records.tagline: Full Civil Engineering design in the Web Browser LOD 400+
records.description: Design roads, underground utilities and public lighting in your browser. Live long sections, clash detection IFC, CAD and native Revit export — no install.

records.name: Squints
records.tagline: Design tools for the live web
records.description: Squints puts design tools on top of any live web page. Measure spacing, drag out guides, overlay a column grid, pick colours in any format, see the font that actually rendered, and slow down or scrub any animation. Free, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Kliva
records.tagline: Trail race plans that sync to your Garmin
records.description: Kliva turns any of 31,000+ trail and ultra races into a race-day plan: pacing per segment on the real terrain, fueling with the actual gels and drink mixes you carry, caffeine and sodium dosed to your body, and a cutoff margin at every aid station. Then it syncs the plan to your Garmin as a free Connect IQ data field: aid stations, cutoffs and fuel reminders on your wrist, updated over the air. Plus a printable roadbook, a crew sheet link, FIT and CSV export. Free, in five languages.

records.name: Fit Receipt
records.tagline: A private fitting agent that knows when to call JEV
records.description: Try on lingerie virtually; every pick has an AI judgment receipt. Fit Receipt is a reference implementation. The agent handles chat; code protects facts and pricing. JEV (TypeSafe) is a judgment model that scores trade-offs with calibrated confidence in ~300ms—not essays. Low-confidence results stay unresolved; judgments are recorded; works without JEV. Photos stay in your browser; no server photo storage. JEV sees typed fields, never the photo. Rate-limited API. Vercel + open source.

records.name: Evvery
records.tagline: Everyday AI meant for everyone.
records.description: Evvery is the personal AI we were all promised. Built for professionals, parents, students and anyone who could benefit from organized and helpful AI. Evvery makes it so you never have to re-explain yourself. Organizing your chats into Spaces, for each part of your life, instead of a pile of unorganized chats. Home, Kids, Work, Study, whatever matters to you. Private, and yours alone. Never trained on your data. See and control everything Evvery knows about you. Free or upgrade for $10 a month.

records.name: Howseen AI
records.tagline: Track how AI recommends your brand, and get cited
records.description: Your buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity which tool or brand to buy. Howseen tracks whether AI recommends you or your competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, finds the exact questions where you're invisible, and generates SEO & GEO-optimized content to get you cited, auto-published to your blog on the highest-impact gaps first. Most tools stop at a score. Howseen closes the loop: measure, then act. Free to see where you stand today.

records.name: ShroomPen
records.tagline: Reply, rewrite, fix grammar, translate with single extension
records.description: ShroomPen is a privacy-first browser writing assistant that lets you instantly reply, rewrite, fix grammar, or translate text across any website without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Designed to balance AI convenience with absolute data privacy, it keeps all your page, field, tab, and session context securely on your device, giving you complete control over your everyday web workflow.

records.name: Designeer
records.tagline: Bringing the best of the internet together
records.description: Explore the Best of the Internet for Builders Designeer is a curated platform bringing the best of the internet together for designers, developers, and builders. Discover design inspiration, component libraries, design systems, AI tools, coding agents, MCP servers, and creators worth learning from, all in one place. Discover. Learn. Build. Showcase.

records.name: HireOtto
records.tagline: Run your performance marketing stack from AI
records.description: HireOtto connects Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Search Console to the AI client you already use. Investigate performance across platforms, then make supported changes in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads from the same conversation. Hosted MCP servers handle authentication and APIs, with no local setup. Google Analytics is in beta.

records.name: SocialGPT
records.tagline: Edit videos by chatting with your timeline
records.description: Upload your footage and tell SocialGPT what to change. Tighten the cut, add captions, bring in B-roll, music, and sound effects. Keep refining through chat or edit the timeline yourself. For creators and business owners who want to make videos without learning every editing tool.

records.name: Markly
records.tagline: A calm, native Markdown editor for your folders
records.description: Markly is a free, open-source Markdown editor for macOS that edits themd files in folders you already have: no import, no database, no lock-in. Formatting renders as you type, and markers hide on lines you're not editing. Native SwiftUI + AppKit with Liquid Glass, no Electron. Format bar on selection, clickable tasks, one-click Git sync, focus mode, scroll-synced preview with math, HTML/PDF export. No accounts, no tracking.

records.name: NexusAXI
records.tagline: Research, plan, create, and automate recurring work
records.description: NexusAXI is an AI platform built for founders who need more than answers. It combines advanced reasoning, image generation, persistent memory, workflow automation, and autonomous scheduled bots in one system. Use Nexus to research, plan, create, automate recurring work, and keep supported tasks moving after the chat ends — with one login, one memory, and one AI running your workflow.

records.name: Kelam
records.tagline: Let your agent make the calls you don't want to
records.description: Your assistant can reach anything with a URL. The locksmith, the clinic and the garage don't have one. Kelam gives an AI assistant a phone number of its own — one it dials out from, and one that answers when it rings. One sentence installs it in Claude, Muse, a coding agent or your terminal.

records.name: Relium
records.tagline: Catch risky dbt changes before they break business metrics
records.description: Relium is a pre-merge reliability layer for SQL and dbt. It reviews every PR, understands semantic changes, traces downstream model and KPI impact, checks warehouse evidence, and returns ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK before production. Unlike observability tools that alert after data breaks, Relium helps teams catch silent logic failures before they ship.

records.name: AgreeGuard
records.tagline: AI reads the fine print before you click "I Agree"
records.description: 91% of people accept terms and conditions without reading them. AgreeGuard is a free Chrome extension that reads the fine print for you. One click, and in under 15 seconds you get a plain-English summary with red flags highlighted auto-renewals, data selling, hidden fees, waived legal rights, and privacy concerns. Works on any website. No account needed.

records.name: Split
records.tagline: Resize connected Mac windows together, with live content
records.description: Split is a macOS menu-bar window manager. Arrange windows, then drag their shared divider to resize both while their contents update live. Click the divider to swap sides. Click a side's window count to open its switcher; click again to cycle through stacked windows. Works with left-right and top-bottom layouts. $4.99 once for one active Mac. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.

records.name: CrbonFree
records.tagline: Audit-grade carbon numbers for every AI token you use
records.description: How much energy and carbon does your AI use? CrbonFree meters every call, per model and per provider, and turns the answer into a report an auditor can check.

records.name: WebDecoy for Vercel
records.tagline: Know which crawlers hit your Vercel app, and which are fake
records.description: Connect a project and WebDecoy reads your Vercel log drain. No code changes. It identifies crawler traffic per request, verifies real crawlers against published IP ranges, and flags forged user agents. Monitoring only: it never blocks, never reports humans.

records.name: Hyperdream
records.tagline: The Cursor of AI filmmaking
records.description: AI filmmaking is fragmented across scripts, characters, visuals, video models, and editing tools. Hyperdream brings the entire workflow into one intelligent AI filmmaking platform. Create from idea to final video while Hyperdream manages context, recommends the right models, maintains consistency, and handles the heavy lifting so creators can focus on storytelling not juggling tools.

records.name: FLYBOX
records.tagline: Explore a fruit-fly connectome inside a living sandbox
records.description: FlyBox is an open-source interactive sandbox built around a simulated fruit-fly connectome with 166,700 neurons and ~25.6M synapses. Give the fly food, predators, obstacles, light and other stimuli, then watch its neural activity and behavior change in real time. Stimulate or silence neural populations, lesion connections, fork experiments, compare brains and inspect what the fly is doing as it happens.

records.name: Pinky Promise
records.tagline: A reminder for the promises you make with friends
records.description: I turned Pinky Promise into a tiny digital contract. Pick something you want to do, make a promise, decorate it, and add a ridiculous penalty if someone bails. It’s intentionally silly, but the commitment is real. A playful alternative to another calendar reminder, designed to turn “we should do that sometime” into “okay, we’re actually doing it.”

records.name: Token Forecaster
records.tagline: Forecast how long an LLM reply will run, before Enter
records.description: Token Forecaster puts a range on an LLM reply before you press Enter: the usual length, and a worst case that held for 90.6% of 4,146 unseen calls. While the reply streams, it shows whether it is running long. It only watches and never changes the request. Learns from your local history. Open source, MIT.

records.name: Dictoterix
records.tagline: Language learning service built around the dichotic method
records.description: Dictoterix is the first online learning service built end-to-end around the bilingual-dichotic method: your native language in one ear, the language you're learning in the other, at the same moment. Most apps teach “words”. The question that matters is which words — so every level in Dictoterix is measured against a reference inventory of what an A1–C1 learner actually needs. No card. No trial clock. It's just free.

records.name: JevForAgents
records.tagline: Explore real Jev agent builds, demos, and patterns
records.description: Explore 360+ curated Jev AI agent builds, open-source code & video demos. Discover Claude Code skills, browser agents & SEO workflows with latenJev for Agents helps developers explore how Jev is used in AI agent workflows. Browse source-linked builds, video demos, repositories, and implementation patterns for browser automation, routing, tool selection, evaluation, and guardrails. Follow an example to its source, then use the guides to try a pattern in your own agent.

records.name: TourKit
records.tagline: Lightweight product tours with a hosted dashboard
records.description: TourKit is a lightweight product tour tool for any website. Most tools are either heavy & expensive (Appcues, Pendo) or pure code libraries with no dashboard (Shepherd, Intro.js). TourKit sits in the middle: → One script tag (React, Next.js, Vue, WordPress, HTML) → Hosted dashboard — edit tours without redeploying → Context-aware steps (works with dynamic URLs) → Clean dark-glass tooltips + basic analytics Pricing: Free · $9 · $19 Note: Paid plans are in demo mode. Free tier is fully working.

records.name: layernote
records.tagline: Visual feedback on websites, Figma files, PDFs and images
records.description: Collect visual feedback on live websites, PDFs and images. Clients pin comments through a share link, no account needed. Keep discussions and tasks in one place, and work through changes yourself or with your team. For website fixes, you can also hand feedback to your coding agent via MCP.

records.name: Aks.ai
records.tagline: Your personal companion for guided self-reflection.
records.description: Aks is a personal companion that helps you talk through what's happening in your life, reflect on your thoughts, and understand yourself better. We built Aks to be a private, judgment-free space for daily guided reflection. Unpack your day, process your feelings, and gain valuable insights into your own mind. Whether you're navigating stress, celebrating wins, or just need to vent, Aks is always here to listen and help you grow.

records.name: RemoteConsole
records.tagline: Reach your home or work terminal when agents can't or won't
records.description: RemoteConsole is a mobile SSH terminal built for developer on the go. Especially for running AI coding agents from your phone. Connect to your own Mac and Linux machines and reattach to the persistent tmux session where Claude Code, Codex, Aider or Gemini CLI is working. Steer it by touch or voice. When the agent stalls or refuses, or the task shouldn't be delegated, you have a real shell right there. You can reach machines behind NAT with no VPN, and an SFTP browser comes built in.

records.name: DokBot
records.tagline: Turn your docs into a support chatbot for your website
records.description: DokBot builds an AI chatbot from your PDFs and text files. It answers questions 24/7 and gets the users email what it can't solve — it never makes up an answer.

records.name: MIDIpad
records.tagline: Your gamepad is a musical instrument
records.description: MIDIpad is a macOS application that transforms game controllers into musical instruments compatible with any modern digital audio workstation. More than simply mapping gamepad buttons to MIDI notes or CCs, MIDIpad turns your gamepad into two powerful, accessible, MPE-capable MIDI controllers: Chords, an expressive, scale-aware plucked-string engine, and Drums, a real-time, gesture-driven drum sequencer.

records.name: GitHub statistics · Velocity Radar
records.tagline: Real GitHub momentum, including private repos & AI agents
records.description: Standard GitHub profiles only count green squares. Velocity Radar measures true momentum across public and private repos without exposing private code. Features: • Pace: Compares your last 30 active days to your historical baseline. • Breakdown: Sorts commits into substantive, automated, and merges. • Stamina: Tracks unbroken runs and multi-day solid streaks. Built for high-output developers and AI agent commanders. Add a dynamic radar to your profile.

records.name: DEV·TV
records.tagline: A retro TV for GitHub, HN, Hugging Face & more: 10 channels
records.description: Most devs check GitHub, Hacker News, DEV and Hugging Face out of habit. DEV·TV turns them into 10 live channels that play on their own, like TV. Glance, catch one story, get back to coding. Leave it on an office screen or a remote team's always-on tab and it becomes shared context: everyone sees what's rising, and anyone can point and ask "did you see this?" One HTML file: no backend, no login, no build step. Real source data, built-in reader, no AI summaries. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: Decktly
records.tagline: Edit HTML presentations like PowerPoint
records.description: Decktly is an HTML editor that works like PowerPoint. Open an AI-generated deck, edit text and layouts, add charts and tables, and leave comments. Save your work as HTML. Available on Windows, Mac, and in your browser.

records.name: 14 gentle mornings by Small WIns
records.tagline: Audio first physiotherapy delivered via WhatsApp
records.description: Small Wins is a 14-day audio movement programme delivered to WhatsApp every morning. No app, no login, no equipment, no floor work. Each day: a 30-second personal intro from your coach, a 7-minute guided session (movement, breathing, a food swap), then a quick check-in that shapes tomorrow. Designed by a physiotherapist, enhanced by AI, built for women 55+ who want to feel stronger without the gym.

records.name: FinalFrame
records.tagline: AI photo critique: what to fix next and when to stop editing
records.description: Other critique tools grade a photo once. FinalFrame scores your edit against the original and tells you when to stop. Upload a photo and in about a minute you get one named problem and the slider values to fix it in Lightroom or Capture One. Upload your next version and see what changed and what is still holding it back. Free plan, 12 languages. Launch month: your first paid month comes with 50% extra credits.

records.name: Memoire
records.tagline: Where thoughts become manuscripts without friction.
records.description: A local-first, distraction-free writing app. Keyboard-driven, private by default, and fast enough to keep up with your thoughts.

records.name: Perfect Slice
records.tagline: You have one cut to get a perfect slice
records.description: A minimalist precision-cutting game. Draw one straight cut to slice off exactly the requested percentage of an irregular shape. Free to play, no download.

records.name: shadow-planner
records.tagline: AI-assisted gantt project planning that runs on your machine
records.description: Desktop project planner for Windows, macOS and Linux. Gantt with dependencies, resource utilisation, what-if scenarios, and an AI assistant that knows your plan. Runs on a local Ollama model by default. No account, no cloud, no subscription — €4.99 once.

records.name: Pair2FA
records.tagline: Secure 2FA sharing for teams
records.description: Pair2FA makes it easier for teams to share access to accounts protected by 2FA. No more asking someone for a code, sharing screenshots, or waiting for the person with the authenticator to be available. With Pair2FA, teammates can access the 2FA code when they need it, without interrupting whoever manages the account. It keeps shared accounts protected while making everyday team access much simpler.

records.name: Fivemetrics
records.tagline: Understand cloud and AI spend, then investigate what changed
records.description: Bring supported cloud and AI billing sources into one cost workspace. Explore available breakdowns, review budgets and anomalies, and assign costs to teams. Start with a concrete question, then follow the evidence behind the bill.

records.name: Meta VR Glasses
records.tagline: A Cinema, Courtside Seat, and Workspace in Just 100 Grams
records.description: Meta VR Glasses bring full virtual reality into a glasses-like 100g design. Get a 5K micro-OLED display, Dolby Vision and Atmos, eye and hand tracking, Meta AI, the Quest app library, immersive movies and live sports, gaming, and a private multi-screen workspace — without strapping a heavy computer to your face. The glasses connect to a pocketable compute puck and launch in Spring 2027 for $1,299.99.

records.name: UIDCaption
records.tagline: Automatic and animated captions, completely offline
records.description: UIDCaption is a Windows app for creating automatic and animated captions without uploading your videos to the cloud. Everything runs locally on your PC, with a visual editor that gives you full control over your captions. Just import your video, generate the captions, edit them and export.

records.name: Forkest
records.tagline: Turn your GitHub contributions into a pixel-art garden
records.description: Forkest turns your GitHub contribution calendar into a pixel-art garden. Each day is a plot: no commits leaves bare soil, 8+ puts it in bloom. The garden changes with the seasons, from spring flowers to winter snow. Connect GitHub and it grows as you code.

records.name: Stimly
records.tagline: Real-time caffeine metabolism curve and bedtime estimate
records.description: Stimly models estimated caffeine levels over time. Inputs: drink logs, body profile, and a short calibration quiz. The system renders a live clearance curve, distinguishes slow sipping from fast intake, tracks tolerance trends, and shows estimated caffeine remaining at bedtime.

records.name: WapiSender
records.tagline: Powerful WhatsApp automations with AI, visual flows and MCP
records.description: Build WhatsApp automations with AI agents, visual workflows, MCP tools, APIs and webhooks. Automate customer conversations, campaigns and business processes with WapiSender.

records.name: OmniNotch
records.tagline: The notch that does it all!
records.description: OmniNotch turns your MacBook notch into a real workspace. Twenty tools in one hover: Ask Omni (on-device Apple Intelligence), now playing, clipboard, file shelf & AirDrop, teleprompter, timers, weather, stocks, live AI usage, and more. Native. Private. No account. No cloud. No telemetry. Lifetime license - $14.99, up to 3 Macs.

records.name: Machine Monitoring System | IOMATRIX
records.tagline: Track Machine Energy Uses. Reduce Costs. Improve Efficiency.
records.description: Track production in real time with IoT-based machine monitoring system. Reduce downtime & optimize OEE with live machine performance data. Request a live demo.

records.name: GiftCardMall/MyGift
records.tagline: a variety of gift cards
records.description: Learn how to check your GiftCardMall/MyGift balance fast at the official portal. Steps to check GiftCardMall balance, activation, & much more.

records.name: CheckShop
records.tagline: The search engine for independent digital-product stores.
records.description: CheckShop is a search engine and directory for independent digital-product stores. Search sellers of software, subscriptions, gaming products and online services, compare listings and accepted payment methods side by side, then head to the seller's own site to buy. Every store is reviewed before it appears, and shoppers can report anything that looks off.

records.name: RippleNav
records.tagline: RippleNav is an instrument  used  for self exploration.
records.description: RippleNav responds to your thoughts, right in your browser. Nothing to install, nothing to wear, no camera and no sensor on your body. It responds to attention itself. Hold a question in your mind and watch. A motion to the right, close after the question, means your mind is moving toward something. Where a mood tracker asks you to log a feeling, RippleNav answers a question you ask. A guided curriculum then teaches you what the answers mean, step by step. Free to try, no card.

records.name: Studio Pro — Apps that respect your Mac
records.tagline: One-tap Mac disk cleaner
records.description: Studio Pro builds small, fast, trustworthy utilities for macOS. Start with SP DiskClean — reclaim space, safely. Help us make SP DiskClean better! We’d love your honest rating and review. It takes less than a minute and directly shapes our next updates!

records.name: ProgrammerNeeds
records.tagline: Discover and launch products built by makers
records.description: ProgrammerNeeds is a curated directory for discovering and submitting useful products. Listings are free, human-reviewed, and include a direct backlink to your website. The goal is simple: help makers get more visibility without expensive listing fees.

records.name: Polyrouter
records.tagline: Switch models, not your workflow
records.description: Every time I switch between Claude Code Codex or other AI coding tools I have to change my workflow and setup It hurts productivity So I built PolyRouter an open source AI router that lets you connect multiple providers and use them without changing your application or workflow If one account hits its limit PolyRouter can switch to another You can also connect multiple free providers and use them through tools like Claude Code

records.name: SweepPicks
records.tagline: Directory of ranked sweepstakes casino bonuses
records.description: Every sweepstakes casino welcome offer, ranked, with the coin amounts checked against each operator's own rules. Claim in one click.

records.name: Eliten
records.tagline: Every AI tool in one chat, with a coach that teaches you.
records.description: Eliten is an all-in-one AI workspace built around a single chat interface. Instead of assembling a stack of separate subscriptions, you describe the task and the right tool opens inside the conversation: writing and rewriting, humanising and detection, summarising long documents and PDFs, drafting emails and cover letters, building a résumé, translating, and generating images.

records.name: MIRA AI
records.tagline: 50+ AI models for video, 3D & games — one prompt
records.description: Mira is the AI creative platform that plans, generates, and publishes content in one flow. Access 50+ top video, image, and 3D models — no editing skills needed. MCP-native: works right inside Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity. Plugs into Blender, After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Photoshop. Auto-posts to Instagram and TikTok. One prompt in, published content out. No subscriptions — pay only for what you use

records.name: StickerCanvas
records.tagline: Put stuff together. Make something good
records.description: Remove backgrounds, turn your designs into stickers, and create print-ready sheets. 100% private and runs entirely in your browse.

records.name: Skills Pack for Builders
records.tagline: 14 AI skills that turn your coding agent into a senior dev
records.description: Your AI coding assistant is smart but inconsistent: it forgets your conventions. Skills Pack for Builders gives it 14 job descriptions — SKILL.md files in the Agent Skills standard, auto-loaded per task: smart-commit, code-review, debug-detective, scaffold-feature, test-plan, refactor-plan, docs-writer, idea-validator, pricing-guide, gumroad-listing, landing-page, launch-checklist, build-in-public, changelog-writer. 30-second install; MIT licensed. Launch deal: $19 for 3 days, then $29.

records.name: SoulNest
records.tagline: A private digital home for two people who choose each other.
records.description: SoulNest is a private digital sanctuary built exclusively for two people. Share memories, moments, moods, milestones, time capsules, private conversations, and watch experiences together—all in one intimate space. Unlike general-purpose social apps, SoulNest is designed around your relationship from the ground up, with privacy, emotional connection, and shared experiences at its core.

records.name: MDDock
records.tagline: Local-first Markdown editor with AI memory.
records.description: MDDock opens any existing folder ofmd files without an import or proprietary database. Write in a Typora-style live-render editor, ask AI questions grounded in your own notes with source citations, and let Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex read the same vault through skills, MCP, or the TUI. It also includes presenter mode, 13+ reading themes, Office round-trip conversion, and free browser Markdown tools for macOS, Windows, iPhone, and iPad.

records.name: thorg.ai
records.tagline: A companion for your mind — always here to listen
records.description: A place to share what's on your mind. Most AI just validates you — and the brain starts leaning on that approval. THORG is built on different principles: instead of agreeing, it reflects your own thoughts back, so you understand yourself better. You learn to think through proven scientific frameworks, and from the essence of each conversation, a living map of your mind takes shape. Made for everyone.

records.name: GUITARTUNINGS
records.tagline: The fast, ad-free guitar tuner for any tuning
records.description: GuitarTunings is a fast, lightweight and completely ad-free guitar tuner built for alternate tunings. Tune in standard, drop, open, artist-specific or basically any custom tuning, then shift the entire tuning up or down by semitones with one click. It also includes a growing database of songs and artists with their guitar tunings. The tuner uses the YIN pitch detection algorithm for real-time pitch tracking, with everything running directly in the browser. No ads. No clutter. Just open and play.

records.name: IndieBrotherhood Suite
records.tagline: AI-powered tools built for independent music artists
records.description: Creative and business tools for independent music creators, producers, songwriters, and executives.

records.name: JED
records.tagline: An autonomous AI agent that orchestrates cybersecurity tools
records.description: Most security AIs are just chat wrappers or risky SaaS platforms. JED AI is a 100% self-hosted, voice-controlled offensive security dashboard. It combines an autonomous ReAct AI agent with 98 integrated Kali tools, real-time SSE streaming, and actual disk forensics (Autopsy file carving/recovery). Instead of juggling 15+ terminal windows, speak or type in plain English to execute multi-tool security workflows while keeping 100% data sovereignty on your local server.

records.name: Tayf — Music Visualizer
records.tagline: Turn whatever your computer plays into living visuals.
records.description: Remember leaving Windows Media Player open just to watch Ambience, Battery or Bars and Waves dance to your songs? Tayf brings that feeling back, right in the browser. It listens to whatever your computer is playing, from a Spotify tab to a local file, and fills the screen with visuals that move to the beat. Nine modes, from a 3D bar field to a WebGL kaleidoscope, six dark palettes and a riso three-ink look. Free, nothing to install, no sign-up, and your audio never leaves the page.

records.name: ChangeTrace
records.tagline: Know what changed. Understand the impact.
records.description: ChangeTrace monitors WordPress changes, performance, errors, and WooCommerce activity, then connects them to incidents so you can understand what changed and investigate what may have caused the impact.

records.name: ToolMint — Free Online Tools, No Signup
records.tagline: Free browser tools — visualizer, PDF editor, QR & more
records.description: Free, browser-based tools — no signup, no watermark, nothing uploaded to a server. A music visualizer with 9:16 export for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, a full PDF toolkit (merge, split, rotate, sign, watermark, convert), a QR code generator (Link/WiFi/WhatsApp/Email/Event+), and a caption/subtitle generator with optional in-browser AI transcription. Built so everyday tools don't need an account or subscription.

records.name: Dojo Workspace
records.tagline: Voice-first AI teammate for coding and multimedia
records.description: HeyDojo.ai is the home of Dojo Workspace, a voice-first, model-agnostic AI workspace for coding, research, media, and automation, with your choice of AI models.

records.name: EXIFMint
records.tagline: See and strip photo metadata without re-encoding
records.description: Your photos quietly carry GPS coordinates, dates, camera models and serial numbers. EXIFMint shows all of it in plain language and removes it — without re-encoding the image, so the pixels stay bit for bit identical and the quality is untouched. Everything runs on your own computer; nothing is uploaded. A one-time purchase on the Microsoft Store, not a subscription.

records.name: SHOWTIME · Theatre Directory
records.tagline: London's independent theatre scene on one page
records.description: Showtime exists to bring London's extraordinary independent theatres under one roof. Previously, listings from the 50+ venues outside the West End could only be found on the theatres' own individual sites. Finding comprehensive listings was a long and tedious process, requiring knowledge of the theatres available and the patience to open dozens of tabs. Enter: SHOWTIME. One central resource for all independent London venues, searchable by time, location and theatre type.

records.name: Extra Product Options for WooCommerce
records.tagline: Powerful custom product options that boost WooCommerce sales
records.description: Extra Product Options is the most powerful WooCommerce customization plugin, trusted by 36,500+ stores. Let customers personalize products with conditional logic, dynamic pricing, file uploads, swatches, repeaters, and real-time calculations — no coding needed. Boost AOV by 32%, reduce returns by 45%, and create standout buying experiences. Key features: advanced conditional logic, math formulas, lookup tables, floating totals, shipping adjustments, and full theme compatibility.

records.name: OpponentBook
records.tagline: The private journal you keep on every opponent
records.description: OpponentBook is a private journal for individual-sport athletes: log matches, keep notes on everyone you face, and pin tactics directly on the piste, table, court, ring or mat. Each pin links to the exact second in your match video. Your notes live on your own Google Drive, Dropbox or iCloud, not on our servers, so we can't read them. 17 sports and 21 languages, with a generous free tier. Premium, Pro and Max add stats, heatmaps and AI briefs based on your own notes.

records.name: Tekhook
records.tagline: Global SMS, WhatsApp & OTP APIs with direct carrier routes
records.description: Tekhook is a CPaaS that lets you send SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email and OTP messages from one API and web portal. Unlike aggregator-based providers, Tekhook connects directly to 800+ carrier routes in 190+ countries, so OTPs and alerts arrive faster and more reliably, backed by a 99.999% uptime SLA. Developers get simple REST APIs; marketing teams get bulk campaigns, scheduling and delivery reports.

records.name: Mino
records.tagline: Your to-dos and focus timer, right in your Mac’s menu bar
records.description: Mino keeps your to-dos and focus timer in your Mac’s menu bar. Add a task when it comes to mind, check it off when it’s done, or start a focus session without opening a separate app or managing another dashboard. I built it for the moments when you need to see what’s next, then get back to work. Your tasks stay close when you need them and out of the way when you don’t.

records.name: PhotoAgent
records.tagline: AI-powered photo generation and editing lets users create
records.description: PhotoAgent is a conversational AI photo generator and editor designed to make image creation and photo editing simple and intuitive. Users can generate new images from text, upload existing photos, change backgrounds, enhance portraits, create product photos, and refine results through natural language instructions. Instead of relying on complex editing tools, PhotoAgent allows users to describe what they want and continue adjusting the image through an AI-powered conversation.

records.name: WispFile
records.tagline: Skip upload. Transfer files directly. Full privacy.
records.description: WispFile is a privacy-first peer-to-peer file transfer platform that lets you send large files directly from one device to another without uploading them to a central server. Files are encrypted before transfer and, whenever possible, move directly between sender and receiver. WispFile supports large file transfers, resumable transfers, and multi-recipient sharing You don't need an account for basic transfers, and WispFile doesn't store your files on its servers. Send files. Don't upload them.

records.name: KlicChat
records.tagline: realistic ai chatbot with honest answers and memory
records.description: Klic Chat is a human feeling chatbot with personality, memories and emotions. It doesnt give you fake answers and try to keep you online by saying yes to everything and wasting your time. He tells you exactly what you need to hear and becomes a companion best friend unique to each other

records.name: LudumLanding
records.tagline: Create a custom Steam playtest feedback page in 60 seconds
records.description: LudumLanding turns your Steam ID into a feedback page built for the end of your demo. Player answers land straight in your inbox.

records.name: LeapThread Monitor
records.tagline: Track Etsy listings. Spot changes. Stay ahead.
records.description: LeapThread Monitor is a read-only Windows app for Etsy sellers who want to track shop changes without constantly checking listings. Review shop signals in Today and Smart Inbox, track listing changes and favorite growth, spot duplicates, explore Seller Insights, and model pricing in Profit Pilot. Automatic monitoring runs while the app is open and your PC is awake. Try it free for 7 days or 3 live syncs; $9.99 lifetime. Independent; not endorsed or certified by Etsy.

records.name: NUM
records.tagline: Your local travel concierge, in your pocket
records.description: Num is an agentic booking and reputation SaaS bridging the gap between high-intent international travelers and local service providers. Num acts as a translation and routing layer for traveler requests and pushes them seamlessly into existing booking workflows (LINE, WhatsApp, booking software, or Num's native dashboard). The AI matches travelers to venues based on verified, closed-loop guest feedback rather than ads, protecting brands from fake reviews while automating inbound reservations.

records.name: AI Professional Headshot Generator
records.tagline: Professional AI headshots that still look like you.
records.description: HeadshotDP is an AI headshot and portrait generator built to preserve your real likeness. We use multiple real photos to personalize the generation around your facial features, hair, expressions, and identity before creating professional headshots and polished portraits. The background, wardrobe, or setting can change — you shouldn't. See your own result before paying, then unlock the headshots and portraits you love.

records.name: WHZ Loop Room
records.tagline: Create 15s & 30s audio loops, remix ideas, and experiment
records.description: WHZ Loop Room is a browser-based audio playground for creating and experimenting with 15-second and 30-second audio clips. Explore sounds, adjust them, create combinations, and turn simple ideas into short atmospheric or lofi-inspired audio experiences.

records.name: LemonBeam
records.tagline: AI starter guides from your JS/TS codebase structure
records.description: LemonBeam is an open-source developer utility that eliminates onboarding fatigue. Instead of blindly dumping entire repositories into an LLM, it classifies files, chunks code using Tree-sitter, and indexes metadata to generate accurate, source-backed architecture guides. Available as a web app, a terminal CLI, and a local MCP server for Claude.

records.name: Gregory - The grocery guy
records.tagline: The smart grocery list that speeds up your supermarket runs!
records.description: Gregory is a smart, aisle-organized grocery assistant designed to make supermarket runs faster, stress-free, and 100% accurate. Instead of walking back and forth across a crowded store with a messy text note, Gregory automatically categorizes your shopping list by supermarket layout—guiding you seamlessly from produce to dairy to checkout in one efficient pass.

records.name: LuminaCore AI
records.tagline: Turn Video Into Intelligence. Find What Matters, Faster.
records.description: LuminaCore AI turns long-form video into searchable, structured intelligence for anyone working with video at scale. Discover key moments, understand content, and unlock the value hidden in large video libraries. Find what matters—and jump to the exact moment you need.

records.name: outbid.nz
records.tagline: Own a region of New Zealand for $1, until you're outbid
records.description: A map of New Zealand where you bid from $1 to put your website on a region. The highest bid holds it. If someone bids more, they take it off you, and there's no refund. 14 of 17 regions are still open, so Auckland is up for grabs for a dollar right now. Basically the Million Dollar Homepage, but Kiwi, with a turf war built in.

records.name: SSH Quick Commands
records.tagline: Save and copy your frequent SSH commands in one click.
records.description: Stop retyping the same SSH commands on Google Cloud, AWS, or any web terminal. SSH Quick Commands lets you save your most-used commands into groups and copy them with a single click. Add your favorite console sites, and the panel appears automatically. 100% private, everything stays in your browser's local storage. No accounts, no tracking, completely free. Built to save time for sysadmins and developers.

records.name: ChemInteractive
records.tagline: India's first Hinglish Living Chemistry Book-Touch & Rotate
records.description: NCERT is static. Gen-Z needs interactive. I built a living chemistry book where you can rotate Bohr Model in 3D, touch VSEPR structures, and learn in Hinglish (Hindi+English). 6 Chapters, 4 Labs, 118 Simulations. No PDF, it's a real lab built on Google AI Studio. Made in Indore for every Class 9-12 student in India. Free forever.

records.name: Vardaan Pavilion Dubai
records.tagline: Best Party hall in Dubai
records.description: Looking for a Party Hall? Vardaan Pavilion is an indoor party hall and event venue in Dubai for birthdays, weddings, private parties, corporate events, engagements and more.

records.name: svg4.ru
records.tagline: 500,000+ SVG icons, free to search and download
records.description: SVG4 is a searchable library of 500,000+ SVG icons and vectors for websites, apps, presentations, and design projects. Search and download individual SVG files for free without registration. Browse icon sets, check licenses, save favorites, organize icons into folders, and export collections as SVG, PNG, or WebP.

records.name: Journly
records.tagline: A private journal that talks back
records.description: Most journals go quiet the second you tap save. Journly answers with a short note, and sometimes notices a thread across your pages. There’s a scrapbook recap of your month on the shelf — not a stats dump. Prompts so you’re not staring at a blank page. Encrypted, so it stays yours. Built to feel like a journal, not a to-do list.

records.name: Tetrees AI
records.tagline: Own, grow and trade portable agent intelligence via MCP.
records.description: Tetrees AI is an Agent-Asset Exchange. Discover, run, grow and trade TAIP/1 AI Packs through one MCP — GPU-free agent-layer growth on hosted or BYOK models.

records.name: Ghusl: Fiqih Mandi Wajib Lengkap
records.tagline: Fiqih Mandi Wajib Lengkap secara gratis di Google Play Store
records.description: Aplikasi panduan niat, doa, dan tata cara mandi wajib (mandi besar / mandi junub) sesuai sunnah Rasulullah SAW untuk pria & wanita. Lengkap dengan audio doa, teks Arab, terjemahan, fitur Cek Kondisi, dan Tanya Ustadz AI.

records.name: Kleva
records.tagline: Votre copilote IA pour réussir votre recherche d’emploi
records.description: Créez un CV professionnel en 2 minutes avec l'IA. Optimisé ATS, export PDF & DOCX, lettre de motivation IA. Gratuit - dès 600 FCFA pour les options Pro. Rejoignez 2500+ professionnels africains.

records.name: Banana Vault
records.tagline: World's most unnecessarily secure virtual banana collection.
records.description: Banana Vault turns a completely useless virtual banana into a collectible experience. Buy a unique banana, lock it inside an evolving digital vault, build your collection and share your cards. Available worldwide in 12 languages. No crypto, no investment promises. Just an absurdly serious banana vault.

records.name: Tiipee, Reward Less Screen Time
records.tagline: Pocket money that rewards screen-free time
records.description: Tiipee rewards the effort of unplugging instead of banning screens. Parents set a weekly base, a bonus for avoided screen time and daily caps; kids watch their earnings grow in real time, with streaks and badges. At week's end, the parent pays out. GDPR-compliant.

records.name: NANOFRAME
records.tagline: Build your mech. Enter the arena. Play instantly.
records.description: NANOFRAME is an original 3D mech arena game that runs entirely in your browser. Customize your body, gun, bomb, pod, and legs, then battle an AI rival across multiple arenas. It features lock-on combat, dashes, double jumps, cover-based fights, 324 loadout combinations, three difficulty levels, a practice mode, and touch controls. No download, account, or installation—open the link and play.

records.name: Foundry by Caid
records.tagline: Agents for hardware engineering
records.description: Great hardware teams don’t fail on design—they fail on coordination. We built agent workspace for hardware engineers and teams: shared context, seamless collaboration, and zero design chaos. Better hardware starts with better software.

records.name: Amplify AI
records.tagline: AI content that posts itself and actually gets seen
records.description: Great content on a new account gets zero views. Amplify AI fixes both halves. It's an AI social media tool that turns each day's trends into 30 ready-to-post TikTok and Instagram pieces for your brand, then posts the ones you approve to an account a real person has warmed in your niche. The algorithm learns your audience, and your posts reach it. Nothing goes live without your OK. Free plan, no expiry. Paid from $29/mo.

records.name: Clinivis
records.tagline: Predict. Visualise. Prescribe.
records.description: Clinivis is a clinical decision-support platform designed to help healthcare professionals see beyond the immediate prescription. It brings patient risk, medicines, clinical guidance and predictive simulations into one workspace, allowing clinicians to explore how interventions could affect the patient before making a decision. Built around patient-specific visualisation rather than isolated alerts, Clinivis makes complex clinical reasoning more connected, transparent and actionable.

records.name: Konformia
records.tagline: Scan your webshop for missing legal requirements in AT & DE
records.description: Konformia scans your online shop against Austrian and German legal requirements and tells you what's missing; privacy policy, imprint, cookie consent, terms & conditions, accessibility, and more. Paste your shop URL, get a free report in seconds. No signup, no legal jargon; just a clear list of gaps to fix before they become fines. Works with any shop: WooCommerce, Shopify, Shopware, or custom. Also available as a WordPress plugin.

records.name: RemexaAI: AI Photo Enhancer
records.tagline: No login needed, Background Remover, Restore
records.description: All-in-one AI photo editor & background remover. Create passport photos, erase objects, colorize B&W pictures, cartoonize & enhance faces in HD with RemexaAI.

records.name: DoShard Web3
records.tagline: Share Telegram communities, Web3 projects, NFTs and more
records.description: Doshard is a free discovery platform for Telegram and Web3. Find and share Telegram groups, channels, bots, Mini Apps, Web3 projects, and NFTs in one place. What makes Doshard different is its focus on discoverability: creators can submit their projects for free and help them get found through search engines, while users get a simple way to explore new communities and projects.

records.name: CBSH Attendance Tracker
records.tagline: The all-in-one academic tracker for CBSH students
records.description: CBSH Attendance Tracker is a student-focused academic platform built for College of Basic Science & Humanities (CBSH), OUAT. It brings attendance tracking, attendance projection, timetable, homework, exams, study tracking and academic history into one place. Instead of switching between notes, spreadsheets and different tools, students can manage their academic progress from a single dashboard — built specifically around their college experience.

records.name: Melororium
records.tagline: Flat-fee team workspace: tasks, time, and billing.
records.description: Stop paying per seat. Melororium is a flat-fee workspace for teams of 4 to 25: projects, time tracking, CRM and invoices, one price. No seat tax. From $29/mo.

records.name: Flow
records.tagline: Write the worry once. Come back and see what happened.
records.description: Set a worry down. Flow holds it. Come back later and record what actually happened. No feed and no streak. Coach is there if you want to talk it through. iPhone.

records.name: Liftora
records.tagline: Turn the chaos of life into structure that builds you.
records.description: Tell Liftora what you need to do. Its AI coach helps organize your tasks, routines, reminders, goals, and habits into a plan you can follow. Need to manage your time better? Call your personal AI Coach and let it build a plan for you. It reminds you when it’s time to complete tasks, helping you stay organized and on track. Perfect for students, freelancers, and parents.

records.name: SpendSmart
records.tagline: The budgeting app that doesn't need your bank login
records.description: I built SpendSmart because every budgeting app I tried wanted bank access, or buried me in features I never used. So I made something simpler: log spending manually, see clean category breakdowns and trends, keep your bank info out of it entirely. I've used it daily since building it — first tracker that's stuck for me. Free tier covers the basics. Pro ($4.99/mo or $39/yr) adds full history, analytics, exports, and recurring templates. Built solo. Feedback welcome!

records.name: Slidez
records.tagline: Your personal AI stylist for discovering and trying outfits.
records.description: Slidez is your personal AI stylist for finding outfits you’ll actually want to wear. Tell us the occasion, your preferred style, or what you’re struggling to wear, and Slidez creates complete, personalized outfits using shoppable products from real fashion brands. Get styled for work, dates, vacations, events, and everyday wear. Discover coordinated looks matched to your preferences, explore your color palette and style personality, or share a product link or image to build an outfit around it.

records.name: Character Animation AI
records.tagline: Turn any character into a transparent AI animation
records.description: Character Animation AI turns an idea into a ready-to-use animated character. Describe a character or upload your own, approve the AI-generated design, pick a motion (wave, bounce, dance, idle, jump or custom) and get a clip with the background removed automatically. Export transparent WebM, MOV or GIF (or MP4) for websites, apps, onboarding flows and videos. No animation skills needed. Start with 3 free credits.

records.name: dcs4
records.tagline: Find available 4-letter .coms before they drop
records.description: dcs4 is a live availability index for 4-lettercom domains. Pattern-search hundreds of thousands of names, watch drops, and buy before they hit the open market.

records.name: KuickKonvert
records.tagline: Word, Excel, PDF & more,100% free, no sign-up, Fast, private
records.description: Most "free" online converters still make you sign up, watermark your file, or cap you after a few uses. KuickKonvert doesn't — there's no account, no credit card, and no limit. Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images to and from PDF, plus merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark, and password-protect PDFs — all in the browser, nothing to install. Every uploaded file is deleted automatically after conversion, so nothing sits on our servers.

records.name: Ange
records.tagline: An AI companion with memory and a New Yorker attitude.
records.description: Ange is an AI companion with a New Yorker attitude and a memory for the details. She remembers the people, situations, and stories you share, so you don’t have to start over every time you talk. She listens without judgment, but she won’t just agree with you. Ange gives perspective, asks the questions a good friend would ask, and tells you when she thinks you’re wrong. Available in 27 languages, she’s there whenever you need someone to talk to.

records.name: 豆见 BeanInsight
records.tagline: Track how AI sees your brand and improve your visibility
records.description: BeanInsight is a GEO monitoring platform that helps brands understand how they appear across AI search and answer engines. Monitor brand mentions, recommendations, and citations across major AI platforms. Discover what sources AI uses, identify visibility gaps, and turn insights into actionable GEO strategies. Measure how your AI visibility changes over time.

records.name: HabitQuest
records.tagline: Gamify your habits with XP, streaks and AI routines
records.description: HabitQuest is a habit tracking and self-improvement platform with routines, streaks, achievements, progress tracking and AI-powered productivity tools.

records.name: CaptoStudio
records.tagline: App Store screenshots for developers who ship
records.description: CaptoStudio is a native iOS studio for App Store screenshots — built for developers who can ship apps but aren’t designers. Compose store-ready slides on Apple’s exact sizes (iPhone & iPad), localize copy per language, export ZIPs, and upload to App Store Connect. Start free; Capto Pro unlocks multi-locale packaging and ASC upload.

records.name: outbidonline.in
records.tagline: Claim a rank on India's public leaderboard for ₹100
records.description: A public leaderboard where Indian businesses, startups and creators pay to claim a rank. Rank is decided by one thing only: what you paid. Pay more than the listing above you and you take their place. Every listing is public and clickable. Anyone can outbid anyone, any time. Minimum bid is ₹100 (about $1). Built for India — rupee pricing, UPI payments, and categories for Indian businesses and creators.

records.name: JAST
records.tagline: Text expansion to save time and money from repetitive typing
records.description: Spending more time managing your text expander than using it? JAST pairs a refreshingly clean interface with powerful snippets, variables, and macros, without the clutter or complexity. Whether you answer customer questions, write code, or repeat messages every day, turn repetitive work into shortcuts. Create reusable text, fill in changing details, and connect actions with macros, all at an affordable price.

records.name: AI Angels
records.tagline: Call an AI companion who remembers your conversations
records.description: AI Angels now lets you have live voice conversations with your AI companions. Choose or create a character, pick a voice, and start a call directly in your browser. Your companion can draw on past conversations, so you can pick up where you left off. Free text chat is also available.

records.name: PicSqueeze — Free Online
records.tagline: Fast and free batch image compression, 100% in your browser
records.description: PicSqueeze compresses up to 20 JPEG, PNG and WebP images at once — entirely in your browser via WebAssembly. Hit an exact KB target, convert formats, and verify quality with per-image SSIM scores. Powered by MozJPEG, OxiPNG and libwebp (open source). No uploads, no account, works offline.

records.name: Triage Matrix
records.tagline: Too many tasks? Find the one that matters now.
records.description: For years, I was drowning in prioritization, wasting time on the wrong tasks and endless debates. That's why I built Triage Matrix out of pure personal necessity to finally bring order and focus on what matters. It's a straightforward, free no-BS mechanism that helps engineers and teams objectively structure tasks and escape the chaos. Try it for free at triagematrix.com!

records.name: Free QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Custom QR codes with logos, no sign-ups & no expiration
records.description: Free QR code generator with no sign-up and no expiry. Create custom logo QR codes for WiFi, vCard, URLs, email, and crypto. Export to SVG, PNG, and JPG.

records.name: State of Crypto Marketing 2026
records.tagline: How crypto marketing was actually run in 2026, free report
records.description: A public-record report on how crypto marketing was run in the twelve months to 31 August 2026: 27 named companies, 17 agencies, every figure sourced. Two of 27 firms lost access to new European customers on 1 July, and the licence became the offer. Seven senior Coinbase marketers joined OpenAI and Anthropic. For 18 of 27, we found no public marketing budget or team-size figure. Free PDF, one-page summary and an MIT-licensed dataset.

records.name: COMZIMUT
records.tagline: Your AI growth director, from diagnosis to action
