Statt endlosem Swipen dreht sich alles um echte Aktivitäten: Du siehst, was in deiner Nähe passiert – von der Sonnenuntergangs-Wanderung über den Brettspielabend bis zum Lauftreff – und verabredest dich direkt mit Gleichgesinnten. Eigene Aktivität in wenigen Minuten erstellt, passende Leute finden sich. Ideal für Neuzugezogene, für alle, die als Erwachsene.

records.name: RideUp
records.tagline: Roule à plusieurs, sans perdre personne.
records.description: Rouler à plusieurs, c'est s'arrêter tous les vingt kilomètres pour vérifier que personne n'est resté derrière. RideUp règle ça : chaque motard voit les autres sur la carte, et l'application prévient dès que quelqu'un décroche.

records.name: پشت پرده لبخند مادرشوهر
records.tagline: پشت پرده لبخند مادرشوهر
records.description: رابطه عروس و مادرشوهر از قدیم یکی از پیچیده‌ترین و حساس‌ترین روابط انسانی بوده است. اما روان‌شناسی خانواده نشان می‌دهد که بیشتر اصطکاک‌ها، دخالت‌ها یا رفتارهای مبهم، ناشی از خباثت درونی نیست؛ بلکه حاصل ترس از فراموش شدن، تغییر نقش‌های روانی و سوءتفاهم در زبان ارتباطی است. کتاب «پشت پرده لبخند مادرشوهر» با نگاهی نو، روان‌شناختی و کاملاً امروزی نوشته شده تا به شما کمک کند به جای واکنش‌های شتاب‌زده یا تحمل رفتارهای ناخواسته، منطق پشت این رفتارها را درک کنید و کنترل عاطفی زندگی خود را به دست بگیرید.

records.name: Mind ReFactory
records.tagline: Run agents inside your brain.
records.description: A brutal, high-speed framework for refactoring the legacy code running in your head. Your wetware is already running millions of lines of code you never wrote. Childhood malware, cultural patches, corrupted processes. Now you can deploy your own custom agents. Give them targets. Let them tear through your backlog. We are talking about full-auto mind refactoring folks. Sounds insane? But it has been running on human hardware since 2008. Debug your mind. Stop f#cking the deploy. Start living.

records.name: Lapse
records.tagline: Never miss a warranty, return window or renewal again
records.description: Lapse reminds you before warranties, return windows and renewals run out, early enough to actually do something about it. Snap a receipt and it fills in the store, date, price and item, right on your phone. Reminders come 60, 30, 7 and 1 day ahead by default, adjustable per item. A calendar and colour-coded home screen show what needs attention. No account, works offline, your data stays on your device. Free, no ads, no tracking. Android for now.

records.name: LaterOn v2: The agentic email plaftform
records.tagline: Describe an email job once. Get sh*t done.
records.description: Please welcome LaterOn v2: a comprehensive email platform now capable of sending and receiving all types of emails. The platform comes with the agentic email workflows; simply describe an email task once, and the agent handles the execution—from monitoring relevant emails and replying with appropriate context to following up on non-responses and closing the conversation thread once your goal is achieved.

records.name: AI Expense Manager & Tracker
records.tagline: Track expenses naturally with AI
records.description: Stop filling out expense forms. Just type what you spent. AI Expense Manager turns a simple sentence like “lunch 120, petrol 500, groceries 850” into organized transactions ready to review. Track budgets, savings, bills, accounts, lending, credit cards, and family expenses in one app. Ask AI about your spending and get monthly insights. Your data stays under your control with local storage, optional backup, and CSV/Excel export.

records.name: tradescraft
records.tagline: Run the whole business off the job sheet
records.description: Job management for trades with quotes, invoices, sales-tax snapshots, scheduling, dispatch and online payments.

records.name: Basedash MCP write
records.tagline: Build charts and dashboards from Cursor and Claude
records.description: Basedash MCP can now write, not just read. From Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client, ask for a chart or a whole dashboard—Basedash explores the schema, writes and validates the SQL, picks the visualization, and lays it out. The result comes back as a real Basedash chart with a durable link and a rendered image, so you can keep iterating in the IDE or share it with the team. Edit it the same way: “break it out by plan” updates the live chart. Not just read. Write.

records.name: DidWork
records.tagline: Verify agent outcomes, not just tool calls.
records.description: AI agents often report success because a tool call completed, even when the actual outcome is wrong or incomplete. DidWork independently verifies agent work against the expected result, gives agents clear pass/fail gates, and can trigger repair when verification fails. It works through MCP and an SDK, supports multiple providers, and produces shareable verification receipts so developers can see what was checked and whether the work was actually done.

records.name: Kapshot
records.tagline: Screen recordings that look like you edited them
records.description: Kapshot is a screen recorder for people who need polished product demos, tutorials, and videos, without spending time editing them. Instead of recording your screen and then opening a video editor to add zooms, fix the cursor, and frame every interaction, Kapshot does the polish automatically while you record.

records.name: Kaiku
records.tagline: The task tracker your AI agents already know how to use
records.description: A task tracker and wiki built for teams whose work is increasingly done by AI agents. It speaks the API of the tracker most companies already run, so the MCP servers your agents use work unchanged. Built-in MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agents you call in a comment that propose but never decide, and every agent run's cost recorded on the issue it worked on.

records.name: FRCTL
records.tagline: Mind-Bending Media and Live Visuals
records.description: FRCTL is one engine for everything an artist ships and runs in the browser. Import your own footage or create generative shader scenes. Build a look, then pull cover art, a Spotify Canvas or a social clip. Run the loop live with direct full screen output. 190+ effects with infinite modulation and route audio into any parameter. Camera and canvas capture in live mode. Sell your presets or loops right in the Collective or post and comment on the member feed. Create, perform, monetize, collab.

records.name: FocusMode
records.tagline: Free Mode Switcher Component for Framer
records.description: Free Framer Component — FocusMode is a free Interactive component for Framer, on the Framer Marketplace. Build on it with Framer's agent, directly on the canvas.

records.name: Kairn
records.tagline: Turn any recorded convo into actionables and follow ups
records.description: Kairn turns conversations into the people, promises and next steps worth remembering. Capture a meeting—with everyone’s consent—or a quick thought. Review the people, tasks and dates Kairn finds, edit every detail, then save approved contacts, reminders and calendar events to your iPhone. Helpful AI, human control. Install the public TestFlight beta.

records.name: Leumos AI
records.tagline: AI color grading, from first look to final export
records.description: See a look you love? Bring it to your footage with Leumos AI, a browser-based color grading studio built by a colorist. Match your video to a reference image, or let Smart Grade suggest looks for your shot. Preview in motion and fine-tune with easy controls, log support, skin-tone tools, and cinematic effects. Start free with 10 reference matches per month and watermark-free 1080p exports. No download or credit card required.

records.name: Promptic
records.tagline: Optimize GenAI applications for quality and cost
records.description: Promptic is the optimization platform for GenAI applications, better quality at lower cost. Benchmark models, tune prompts and agents, and optimize tool use against your own data and business metrics. Every candidate is scored on the quality and cost you actually care about, so you ship the configuration that wins instead of the one that sounded right. Runs wherever you are, dashboard UI, your CI, or your coding agent.

records.name: DemoScreen
records.tagline: Turn product screenshots into a narrated demo video
records.description: DemoScreen turns screenshots of your product into a finished demo video. Upload your screenshots, and it writes the script, adds a voiceover, background music and captions. Choose from five templates and three formats: 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. Narration is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French. Each video comes with an MP4 file, SRT captions, a GIF and a share link. A free plan is available.

records.name: World Signal
records.tagline: See where the world is behaving abnormally.
records.description: WORLD SIGNAL monitors real-world systems: earthquakes, wildfires, internet connectivity, aviation and more, to detect unusual activity across the planet. Explore anomalies, compare them with historical baselines, and investigate the evidence behind every signal.

records.name: Once UI 2.0
records.tagline: Builds consistent React apps for developers and AI agents
records.description: Once UI is an open-source design system for building polished React products with less repetitive code. Compose layouts with readable primitives, use a shared system of components and design tokens, and keep the result consistent as your product grows. Version 2.0 gives both you and your coding agent a clearer way to work. Its component catalog, compact rules, and task guides help agents use the system correctly; its foundations and predictable APIs make the output easier for you to understand.

records.name: Tripluka
records.tagline: Free Travel Website Builder
records.description: Tripluka gives every tour and travel operator a branded website, an admin panel, and an automated enquiry-to-booking pipeline — free to start, with 100% of every booking’s revenue retained.

records.name: Polyglot
records.tagline: Create and translate subtitles entirely on your Mac
records.description: Turn recordings into subtitles, translate SRT/VTT files, and export readable transcripts on your Mac. Polyglot keeps media and AI processing local, with editing, bilingual exports, batch translation, video enhancement and compression in one native app. Try unlimited transcription and translation for 7 days without an account. Pro is €29.99 once; editing, conversion, exports and video tools stay free. For Apple Silicon, macOS 14.4+.

records.name: Jango
records.tagline: Test multi-user apps with AI agents that act like real users
records.description: Jango lets you test the parts of your app that need more than one person. It gives your app a group of AI users, each with its own browser, account, goals and memory. Point Jango at your dev URL and watch them sign in and interact with each other in real time. Direct them, join in as yourself, or take control of any user's screen. At the end you get a report with actions, errors and screenshots. Use your own AI key or Jango's managed AI. Available on Mac.

records.name: Voxlate
records.tagline: AI subtitles and translation into 50+ languages
records.description: Voxlate turns any audio or video into synced subtitles and translates them into 50+ languages, right in your browser. Whisper transcribes, AI translates, and you download SRT, WebVTT, ASS or JSON with per-word timing. What stands out: animated karaoke-style subtitles (solid or rainbow) in 8 colors, support for video files like MP4, MOV and MKV, and your original audio is deleted once processing is done. 5 free minutes every week.

records.name: NewsBite
records.tagline: News in 60 Seconds.
records.description: NewsBite aggregates headlines from 50+ trusted publishers. We do not produce news — every story links back to its original source.

records.name: Donna
records.tagline: Schedule multiple meetings with one link
records.description: Donna lets you combine a sequence of meetings into a single booking link. Instead of sending different links for every call, one link chains all meetings together with conditions like setting time gaps between meetings or keeping the next meeting locked until the previous one is completed. It also includes built-in workflows to prioritize important meetings, fill cancellations, route meetings across teams, and more.

records.name: AI Visibility Score
records.tagline: What ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini really say about you, free
records.description: See exactly what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity say about your business, with real verbatim answers, not a simulated score. Most AI visibility tools estimate a score from proxy metrics or lock the real report behind a subscription. We do neither. Get one free answer instantly, then unlock the full report free: mention rate, competitor citations, a misinformation check most trackers skip, and a live crawler-access check. Ongoing tracking after is an optional £6.99/mo, never required.

records.name: Docora
records.tagline: Open source React & Next.js docs framework with MCP server
records.description: Docora is an open source documentation framework for Next.js and React. Write MDX, get routing, search, SEO, dark mode and i18n for free. It also ships an MCP server, llms.txt and an in-page assistant, so AI tools can read your docs as well as people can.

records.name: SkiCoach 2.0
records.tagline: Real-time ski & snowboard coach. No hardware. 100% offline.
records.description: Hardware ski coaches need €200+ sensors in your boots plus a subscription; GPS trackers give numbers but no coaching. SkiCoach is neither: the sensors already in your phone score your technique 0-100 and an audio coach talks to you through your earbuds while you ski. No account, no cloud, works in airplane mode. New in 2.0: real snowboard mode, GPS run replay with speed heatmap, Season Intelligence, PDF report, and a one-winter Season Pass with no auto-renew. Free tier stays free. Made in Graz.

records.name: Belmont Publisher
records.tagline: Hire a Ghostwriting Company in USA
records.description: Professional ghostwriting services from a trusted ghostwriter agency. Get matched with a writer in your genre. Book your free consultation today.

records.name: words.fun
records.tagline: 3D UI: write, direct AI, then hear and see images and video.
records.description: You write, a poem, free verse, anything. You can also write a digital greeting card with a selected cover image. Then you choose a voice, and direct how AI should generate images and a short video for your words. Then you play the words to hear and see images for each line, and see the video. Have fun writing creative words in a 3D interface, directing AI, seeing the images and video that AI generated from your directions, and then sharing a link to your words with others.

records.name: Saju Lucky
records.tagline: Free Korean Astrology (Saju) Reading - luck cycle, partner
records.description: \ Saju Lucky reads your Korean Four Pillars (Saju) chart from your exact date and time of birth, not a sun sign. It gives your nature and luck cycle in plain language. Beyond the free reading: a Future Partner reading (age, looks, personality, marriage timing), couple compatibility from two charts, and a 2026 forecast. Readings are reasoned from the classical Chinese texts rather than canned templates. Also includes Saju charts and ideal-type readings for K-pop idols like BTS and BLACKPINK.

records.name: DataMoov for Google Sheets™ (Free)
records.tagline: Don't leave your beloved spreadsheet to get an answer.
records.description: DataMoov brings your marketing, CRM and database numbers into Google Sheets™ and lets you ask for them in plain words. Ask a question and it fetches the real numbers and puts the answer in a new tab. Ask for a dashboard and it builds one, charts included. It all happens in the spreadsheet you already work in. It's free and private and a real Supemetrics alternative!

records.name: Web It Up
records.tagline: A spider spins silk over your camera as meetings run long.
records.description: A little spider spins silk over your Google Meet camera as meetings run long. Wave to clear.

records.name: Jiva Organic
records.tagline: rganic, priced for everyday India
records.description: Created Jiva Organic is a certified-organic marketplace designed for tier-2 India, bringing fragmented organic supply into one trusted basket with visible proof, near-parity pricing, and reliable same-day or next-morning delivery. The MVP starts on WhatsApp — customers can discover products, check organic certification, build one basket across multiple partners, pay, and receive delivery updates without downloading an app.with Figma

records.name: Regulus
records.tagline: Manage clients, payments & projects — even from WhatsApp
records.description: Regulus is a client OS for service businesses, connecting approvals, client requests, invoices, payments, reminders and handoffs in one workflow. This launch introduces Regulus AI on WhatsApp. Businesses can create invoices, generate and send payment links, track payments and manage key client operations directly from WhatsApp, while everything stays connected to their Regulus workspace. Instead of juggling separate tools, Regulus keeps client work moving from request to payment and handoff.

records.name: COOLDOWN
records.tagline: A little pause before your next impulse purchase
records.description: Save what catches your eye, give it time, then decide. COOLDOWN turns shopping links into a personal cooling-off list, with editable product details, countdowns, widgets and optional reminders. Take a Second Look at your original reason before buying or letting go. Plus adds activity trials, purpose comparisons, temptation memory, Worth Keeping and Unbought Receipts. For iPhone. Your first five items are free; Plus offers unlimited new items.

records.name: Tellwe
records.tagline: Your coffee cup tells its story.
records.description: Upload a Turkish coffee cup. Tellwe finds the symbols in the grounds, writes a personal 45-second reading, and brings it to life through a character you can share. The name comes from “telve” the Turkish word for the coffee grounds left in the cup, where the fortune is traditionally read — reimagined as Tellwe: a cup with a story to tell.

records.name: Cutsio
records.tagline: One video asset library shared with your whole team
records.description: Still fiddling with large video files across Hard drives, Google drive links and dropbox folders? Cutsio is an AI native Video Media Asset Management Software that creates a single, shareable video library that your whole team can access with AI auto tagging, AI Summaries, Visual Intelligence, Intelligent content repurposing edits and handing off importable EDL & XML for Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve so that you still retain the human taste in your final edits

records.name: InfraGrid3D
records.tagline: Full Civil Engineering design in the Web Browser LOD 400+
records.description: Design roads, underground utilities and public lighting in your browser. Live long sections, clash detection IFC, CAD and native Revit export — no install.

records.name: Squints
records.tagline: Design tools for the live web
records.description: Squints puts design tools on top of any live web page. Measure spacing, drag out guides, overlay a column grid, pick colours in any format, see the font that actually rendered, and slow down or scrub any animation. Free, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Kliva
records.tagline: Trail race plans that sync to your Garmin
records.description: Kliva turns any of 31,000+ trail and ultra races into a race-day plan: pacing per segment on the real terrain, fueling with the actual gels and drink mixes you carry, caffeine and sodium dosed to your body, and a cutoff margin at every aid station. Then it syncs the plan to your Garmin as a free Connect IQ data field: aid stations, cutoffs and fuel reminders on your wrist, updated over the air. Plus a printable roadbook, a crew sheet link, FIT and CSV export. Free, in five languages.

records.name: PIXA WORK
records.tagline: A beautiful home for your photos, without the noise.
records.description: PIXA WORK photo gallery. PIXA WORK is a clean and distraction-free photo gallery built for people who simply want to share and discover beautiful photography. No clutter, no complicated setup — just photos presented the way they deserve to be. Explore images, discover new perspectives, and share your own work in a simple, visual-first experience.

records.name: VIRAX: Professional Viral Predictor
records.tagline: VIRAX use the best AI models to improve your videos.
records.description: VIRAX is an AI-driven web application designed to help digital marketers, content creators, and agencies analyze, optimize, and predict the viral potential of short-form video content before it is published across social media platforms. By leveraging advanced machine learning models trained on millions of high-performing video scripts and structures, VIRAX transforms content strategy from a game of trial and error into a data-backed science. Available now on the Play Store (I need feedback)

records.name: BrokenRepo
records.tagline: Debug real Codebases. The skill Amazon's OA now tests.
records.description: BrokenRepo gives you a real, multi-file MERN codebase with a genuine bug hidden inside. No skeleton code, no upfront hints. You read the code, form a hypothesis, fix it, and run tests to confirm. Built because most of us can solve DSA problems but freeze at a real error message, and Amazon's 2026 OA now tests exactly this.

records.name: Fit Receipt
records.tagline: A private fitting agent that knows when to call JEV
records.description: Try on lingerie virtually; every pick has an AI judgment receipt. Fit Receipt is a reference implementation. The agent handles chat; code protects facts and pricing. JEV (TypeSafe) is a judgment model that scores trade-offs with calibrated confidence in ~300ms—not essays. Low-confidence results stay unresolved; judgments are recorded; works without JEV. Photos stay in your browser; no server photo storage. JEV sees typed fields, never the photo. Rate-limited API. Vercel + open source.

records.name: nBox
records.tagline: One inbox for LinkedIn and X.
records.description: nBox is a Chrome extension that replaces the LinkedIn and X message UIs with one list. Search every conversation, see what still needs a reply, snooze the rest, and keep labels on the threads that matter. Your message history stays in the browser. nBox does NOT upload the inbox, send messages for you, or run LinkedIn or X actions in the background. Optional reply drafts exist. They run only on the open thread and stay off until you turn them on.

records.name: Evvery
records.tagline: Everyday AI meant for everyone.
records.description: Evvery is the personal AI we were all promised. Built for professionals, parents, students and anyone who could benefit from organized and helpful AI. Evvery makes it so you never have to re-explain yourself. Organizing your chats into Spaces, for each part of your life, instead of a pile of unorganized chats. Home, Kids, Work, Study, whatever matters to you. Private, and yours alone. Never trained on your data. See and control everything Evvery knows about you. Free or upgrade for $10 a month.

records.name: Translatigo - No words Only Voice
records.tagline: No Words, Only Voice Interpretation
records.description: Voice-to-voice interpretation, live, on phone calls and video meetings. You talk, they hear their language. No transcript lag, no "please repeat that." I call it interpretation, not translation. Translation happens after the fact, to a document. Interpretation happens live, in the room, while two people are trying to get something done. Small distinction, matters more than it should. Ships as a Chrome extension. Built for phone interpreters, staffing agencies, healthcare, BPOs.

records.name: Howseen AI
records.tagline: Track how AI recommends your brand, and get cited
records.description: Your buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity which tool or brand to buy. Howseen tracks whether AI recommends you or your competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, finds the exact questions where you're invisible, and generates SEO & GEO-optimized content to get you cited, auto-published to your blog on the highest-impact gaps first. Most tools stop at a score. Howseen closes the loop: measure, then act. Free to see where you stand today.

records.name: Essence
records.tagline: Your life is happening. Don't miss it.
records.description: This is for the people who want to feel alive. Between the kids, the job, and the group chat, your attention is stolen every 60 seconds. Research shows we lose 231 hours of sleep a year just from scrolling in bed. Essence locks your most addictive apps until you've shown up for yourself first. Morning ritual. Nightly wind-down. Powered by Apple's Screen Time, so the lock is real. Your life is happening. Don't miss it.

records.name: ShroomPen
records.tagline: Reply, rewrite, fix grammar, translate with single extension
records.description: ShroomPen is a privacy-first browser writing assistant that lets you instantly reply, rewrite, fix grammar, or translate text across any website without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Designed to balance AI convenience with absolute data privacy, it keeps all your page, field, tab, and session context securely on your device, giving you complete control over your everyday web workflow.

records.name: Designeer
records.tagline: Bringing the best of the internet together
records.description: Explore the Best of the Internet for Builders Designeer is a curated platform bringing the best of the internet together for designers, developers, and builders. Discover design inspiration, component libraries, design systems, AI tools, coding agents, MCP servers, and creators worth learning from, all in one place. Discover. Learn. Build. Showcase.

records.name: andrsrxn/icons
records.tagline: React icon library with 1,000+ duotone icons and 250+ flags.
records.description: The set is lightweight, visually consistent, and accessible. Duotone by default: Icons that have a meaningful path/fill distinction are always duotone. Outline when appropriate: Simple geometric icons such as +, /, or × do not receive a decorative background layer that would only reduce clarity. Filled on demand: A filled variant is included only for icons that have a meaningful active or selected state, such as like, bookmark, or star, not as a blanket alternative style.

records.name: FormWiz
records.tagline: AI-powered form filling for PDFs and documents
records.description: Tired of printing forms, filling them out by hand, and scanning them back in? FormWiz turns PDFs and Word documents into fillable, reusable forms without forcing you to rebuild them from scratch. Upload a form, save your personal, family, or business information once, and reuse it across future forms. FormWiz keeps your profiles, documents, and form history organized, so repetitive paperwork becomes much faster and easier. Built for real-world forms that weren’t designed to be editable.

records.name: Octordle
records.tagline: Solve 8 hidden words at once, 13 guesses
records.description: Octordle is a free word puzzle: solve eight hidden five-letter words at once, using just 13 guesses. Every guess goes to all eight boards, so the challenge grows fast. There's a new daily puzzle every day, an Unlimited mode for extra practice, and two more ways to play: Sequence (one board at a time) and Rescue (four starter words given to you). Daily hints and a word finder help if you get stuck. No account needed. Works on phone and desktop, with a colorblind palette and dark theme.

records.name: Arcadia
records.tagline: Find the place that fits you.
records.description: Seven years to decide where to live: spreadsheets, Notion tables, tabs never closed. Every "best places" list gave me the same thirty cities, none an answer to my life. Traveling taught me each place brings out a different version of you. So I built Arcadia: thirty questions, then it compares 3,582 places worldwide, mostly small towns and islands no list ever names. The first 50 people unlock their results free with code PH. Would love to hear what you think, and where it sends you.

records.name: HireOtto
records.tagline: Run your performance marketing stack from AI
records.description: HireOtto connects Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Search Console to the AI client you already use. Investigate performance across platforms, then make supported changes in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads from the same conversation. Hosted MCP servers handle authentication and APIs, with no local setup. Google Analytics is in beta.

records.name: Wektor
records.tagline: Local-first AI data analysis. Your data never leaves.
records.description: Wektor is a desktop app that answers questions about your CSV or database in plain English, without uploading your actual data anywhere. Only column names and aggregate stats reach the AI model you connect (your own key). The model writes analysis code from that summary, and it runs locally in a sandboxed process against your real data. Charts, trend detection, PDF reports, and a presentation mode included. Free tier works fully offline with sample data, no signup, no API key.

records.name: GOSH.AI DePools
records.tagline: Run the top open-source model at the best possible price
records.description: Join a shared pool on top-tier GPU servers and run the top open-source models (GLM-5.3 and others) at the best possible price, through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so no code change. The pool's throughput is yours, not a shared, rate-limited API queue. Any open model on request, monthly, no multi-year lock. For our launch we opened a $200/month offer so teams can try it, send real workloads, and give feedback.

records.name: gift crad
records.tagline: free gift crad
records.description: The Golden Ticket Gift Card turns every gift into an opportunity. Inspired by the excitement of finding a winning ticket, this campaign positions the gift card as a gateway to rewards, surprises, and memorable experiences. The recipient feels like they've unlocked something special the moment they receive it.

records.name: SocialGPT
records.tagline: Edit videos by chatting with your timeline
records.description: Upload your footage and tell SocialGPT what to change. Tighten the cut, add captions, bring in B-roll, music, and sound effects. Keep refining through chat or edit the timeline yourself. For creators and business owners who want to make videos without learning every editing tool.

records.name: Aqua Edits
records.tagline: The long-form AI VOD editor.
records.description: A long-form AI VOD editor. Aqua Edits turns full Twitch and YouTube streams into finished videos with AI video editing: cuts, zooms, subtitles, and sound.

records.name: ShareGreet AI
records.tagline: AI story greetings, narrated in your own language
records.description: ShareGreet turns a short description into a complete story greeting — written, illustrated in visual styles, and narrated aloud in 30+ regional languages ▎ (Spanish, Arabic, English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, and more). No editing skills needed. Describe what you want to say, pick a style and language, and get a shareable video greeting ▎ in minutes. Free to start, browse without an account, on Android and web now.

records.name: Play Store ASO Extension
records.tagline: Research Google Play apps with ASO insights
records.description: A browser eA browser extension that brings ASO research directly to Google Play. Analyze apps and developers with installs, daily install estimates, release/update dates, keywords, metadata, monetisation, ad networks, compliance, localization and more — without leaving the Google Play page.xtension that adds a full ASO research panel to Google Play app and developer pages: metadata, keywords, monetisation, ad networks, compliance and one-click exports.

records.name: PocketBoss
records.tagline: Booking, invoicing and payments for a trade business of one.
records.description: PocketBoss is the business app for a tradesperson who works alone, or with a helper or two — plumbers, electricians, welders, handymen, cleaners. It gives you a public booking page, a schedule with today's jobs and a route map, a client list, quotes and invoices you can email with a pay link or download as a PDF, card payments through your own Stripe account, expenses with receipt photos, time on the job, and a mileage log. Free; Boss is $14.99/mo. Android and the web today.

records.name: Nightcut
records.tagline: Tell AI about your dream. It makes it a film.
records.description: Nightcut turns your dreams into short films. Just talk — describe your dream, and AI generates a cinematic clip from it. Voice-first, no typing required. How it works: 1. Record yourself describing a dream 2. AI sanitizes it into a cinematic prompt 3. Video generation + post-production (title cards, color grading) 4. Watch, share your dream film Free to try — 3 dreams on signup. Share your dream film with a friend and you both get a free one. your dreams into films. Based on a true dream.

records.name: LaunchKit
records.tagline: 5 Modern Tailwind CSS Landing Page Templates (Zero Build)
records.description: LaunchKit is a premium collection of 5 production-ready landing page templates built with pure HTML5 and Tailwind CSS. ⚡ Zero npm, zero Node.js, zero build setup 📱 100% responsive across all screen sizes 💼 Unlimited commercial license included Includes 5 complete templates: 1. Apex (SaaS) 2. DevCraft (Portfolio) 3. Pulse (Mobile App) 4. Vanguard (Agency) 5. Beacon (Startup Waitlist)

records.name: My Sky Pro

records.description: My Sky Pro turns your astrophotography collection into your own interactive universe. Automatically place deep-sky photos with plate solving, add your planetary shots to a Solar System sandbox, build a complete Moon from lunar images, and fine-tune how every photo blends into the sky.

records.name: Barningo

records.description: Horse barn management software for planning, feeding, client & worker management, and operations in one mobile-friendly system.

records.name: CaseCrop

records.description: Remove irrelevant events from a failing trace while retaining declared prerequisites and replay evidence. Reduce the trace while preserving the same reproducible failure. Requires a replay function. Closure 1-minimality is not a global minimum or proof of root cause.

records.name: Afforya Financial Tools
records.tagline: Free financial calculators & underwriting modeling tools
records.description: Afforya Financial Tools is a suite of 100% free, institutional-grade calculators designed for smart borrowing decisions. Key features included: • Mortgage Readiness & DTI limits validation (28/43 rule) • Early Loan Payoff & interest savings visualizer • Auto & RV financing loan schedule modeler • Comprehensive loan amortization schedules • Interactive 4-step borrower readiness audit All calculations run 100% locally in your browser with zero guesswork and complete data privacy.

records.name: LandEmpire
records.tagline: Paste a product link, get a mobile sales landing page
records.description: Paste a product link from Amazon, AliExpress, eBay, Shopify or almost any online store and get an editable mobile sales page in ~20 seconds: photos, copy, sale price, countdown and an order form that takes international phone numbers. Try it without an account at landempire.tech/try. Leads go to Telegram, email or your CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Bitrix24, Kommo, Close). Custom domain with free SSL, Meta/TikTok/Google pixels, postbacks with sub1, A/B tests with a significance check.

records.name: EXNOW People and Event Nearby
records.tagline: Discover what’s happening around you.
records.description: EXNOW is a location-first social discovery platform that helps people discover what’s happening around them in real time. Find nearby events, community updates, opportunities and people with shared interests. Share location-relevant Drops, create Signals to find people who want to join an activity, and explore communities built around places—not just followers. We’re building a social layer for campuses, neighbourhoods and cities, connecting digital information with real-world participation.

records.name: Tarot Almanac
records.tagline: Tarot numerology for your day, month, year, and birth chart
records.description: In most tarot apps, you shuffle and draw. In The Tarot Almanac, every day already has its cards, set by tarot numerology. There's the collective card we all share, and your personal card, set by your birthday. The gap between them is your Bearing, one card that stays with you for life. Look back at any day you've lived, look ahead a month, and make a seven-card birth chart for yourself or someone you love. Check your cards in the morning, and you'll know whether to bring an umbrella.

records.name: OneCre
records.tagline: Turn your song into a music video you actually direct
records.description: An AI music video director for musicians. Upload a song and OneCre storyboards every scene first. Approve only the shots you want before any video is generated, then get a cut edited to the music. Free to start, credit packs from $2.99.

records.name: Matrix connect
records.tagline: Cloud connectivity made simple with Matrix Connect
records.description: Matrix Connect (formerly Galen Data) eliminates the complexity and high cost of building medical device cloud connectivity from scratch. It provides a purpose-built, secure, and compliant infrastructure that allows engineering teams to connect devices to the cloud in weeks rather than months. Highly scalable and fully configurable, the platform features pre-built compliance frameworks (including ISO 13485, IEC 62304, HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA/EU MDR standards) to eliminate regulatory friction

records.name: 声场-AIShengChang
records.tagline: 小说AI转多角色配音、视频AI翻译配音
records.description: 声场帮内容创作者做 AI 多角色配音：小说转有声书、剧本/故事转音频，以及视频配音。支持原文校对、角色音色确认、逐段修改和私人收听。 AIShengShang helps content creators with AI multi-character voiceover: converting novels into audiobooks, scripts/stories into audio, and video dubbing. It supports original text proofreading, character voice tone confirmation, paragraph-by-paragraph editing and private listening.

records.name: BactiFIND - The Lab in Your Pocket
records.tagline: Mobile Application for Clinical Microbiologists
records.description: BactiFind is a powerful, offline-first mobile application for microbiology professionals and students. By consolidating the comprehensive data of clinical microbiology into a single platform, BactiFind equips healthcare workers with critical data at their fingertips. From rapid organism identification to complex resistance decoding, the app streamlines clinical workflows, ensures data-backed decisions in seconds, and bridges the gap between laboratory data and patient care.

records.name: Body Metrics - Actofit
records.tagline: Body Metrics — a free web dashboard for Actofit scale owners
records.description: The official Actofit app has been broken for months — login errors, no OTP, unresponsive support, leaving scale owners with data they cannot reach. We built Body Metrics at Ascendra Ventures so your readings live in one place again. Your scale, your data. Link: https://actofit-health-tracker.ascendra.one Maker's first comment: Hi PH. A few of us use Actofit scales and got tired of the dead app, so we built this. It is free, would love feedback on what metrics you would want next.

records.name: Anxious Attachment Companion Plus
records.tagline: A private companion for calmer, healthier relationships
records.description: Anxious Attachment Companion Plus helps people navigate relationship anxiety, emotional triggers, and difficult conversations with practical, private tools. It includes daily check-ins, attachment insights, a guided “I’m Triggered” flow, Fact vs Story reflection, message drafting and rewriting support, history, and trigger mapping. Available in English, Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese, with a 1-hour Explorer experience before subscribing. Educational wellness support, not therapy.

records.name: SOLARA 2.0
records.tagline: The AI that edit short form like a pro editor
records.description: AI that edits short-form video like a pro editor. Solara is the AI social media manager: it texts you a script, you film two minutes on your phone, and it edits, captions and posts to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

records.name: Threshold - A Minimal Focus Launcher
records.tagline: The offline focus launcher you can’t willpower out of
records.description: Most focus apps fail because quitting is just one lazy tap away. Threshold is an Android launcher that replaces your home screen with real exit friction. Pick a mode (Work, Study, Sleep, Meditate) and lock in. Choose your strictness level—up to a full launcher takeover with deliberate cooldown delays. Features built-in doom scroll protection to cut off short-form video feeds. 100% offline, zero data collection, no accounts, and no internet access required.

records.name: ProVibe — Creators • Brands • Events
records.tagline: Create. Connect. Experience.
records.description: ProVibe is officially launched — an all-in-one platform connecting Creators, Brands, and Events in one ecosystem. Creators can build their presence, grow their audience, sell digital products and services, and monetize through sessions and opportunities. Brands can discover and collaborate with creators, while event organizers can find creators for promotions and grow their reach. ProVibe brings these three communities together to create meaningful collaborations and new opportunities.

records.name: Matriks Prime
records.tagline: Premium financial data and trading terminal.
records.description: Matriks Prime is the ultimate financial data and trading terminal for professionals. It offers real-time data, advanced technical analysis, and algorithmic trading for BIST, VIOP, and global markets. Build custom indicators, test strategies, and deploy trading robots. Automate your portfolio with smart synthetic orders like trailing stops. Leverage automated pattern recognition and our comprehensive Prime Dashboard for deep financial insights. Trade smarter without constant screen fatigue.

records.name: Matriks Web Trader
records.tagline: Trade and analyze markets anywhere, anytime.
records.description: Matriks Web Trader is a powerful, browser-based financial data and trading platform requiring no installation. Accessible from any device (Windows, Mac, Linux), it offers real-time data tracking for BIST and VIOP markets. Perform deep technical analysis, monitor market depth, and execute trades seamlessly directly from your web browser. Designed for investors who need fast, secure, and flexible access to financial markets anywhere, anytime without compromising on professional tools.

records.name: NotifiQ
records.tagline: Track habits, understand your progress, build consistency
records.description: NotifiQ is a simple habit tracker designed to help you build consistency and actually understand your progress. Create habits, track your daily progress, and explore detailed analytics to see your streaks, consistency, trends, and improvements over time. No complicated productivity system. Just a clean way to track your habits and turn your daily actions into useful insights.

records.name: Craft & Anchor
records.tagline: Craft & Anchor is a creative and digital solutions agecy.
records.description: Craft & Anchor is a creative and digital solutions agency helping businesses turn ideas into impactful brands and experiences. From branding, website & app development, and digital marketing to 3D visualization, interior & exterior design, and FEC & recreation solutions, we bring creativity, technology, and strategy together under one roof. We work with businesses across the globe to build stronger brands, engaging digital experiences, and solutions designed for real growth.

records.name: ATTESIO

records.name: WeightPath Care

records.description: WeightPath Care helps people living with overweight/obesity prepare better conversations with clinicians. Trilingual Arabic, Hebrew, English. Official sources (WHO, NICE, ASMBS/IFSO and more), personal plan from an active profile, GLP-1 companion journal, exercise guidance, surgery decision education and post-op stages, comorbidities checklist, family mode, and milestone rewards — forever free. Built by a physician. Education and clinician-prep only — not prescribing, not a substitute for care.

records.name: Cinetic: What to Watch?
records.tagline: Swipe, match, and decide what to watch with friends
records.description: Cinetic eliminates streaming choice paralysis through card-based curation and collaborative discovery. When connected friends independently swipe right on the same title, it triggers an instant mutual match. The platform features Cinetic Blend (a 6-dimension taste compatibility radar), exportable 9:16 aesthetic passes, personal rating logs, and real-time streaming availability across platforms.

records.name: BatchCanvas
records.tagline: Free bulk certificate & badge maker Fast, private, no signup
records.description: BatchCanvas is a free, privacy-first bulk graphics generator for event hosts, hackathons, educators, and designers. Convert CSV data into hundreds of personalized certificates, badges, and ID cards in seconds. Highlights: • 100% Offline & Private: Zero cloud uploads; your data stays in-browser. • Print-Ready Vector PDFs: Single pages or multi-up grid sheets with crop marks. • Smart Headshot Linking: Auto-match CSV rows to local attendee photos. • Zero Friction: No login or registration required.

records.name: Flint Engine
records.tagline: The eCommerce Operating System
records.description: Flint Engine brings your store, products, orders, customers, marketing, and growth operations into one eCommerce operating system. Self-hosted, fast, built for commerce.

records.name: NeuraLog AI
records.tagline: AI Research Infrastructure for Clinical Trials
records.description: Researchers spend 15–40 minutes per patient visit manually pulling clinical scale scores from notes. NeuraLog AI does it in seconds and shows you the exact sentence every value came from. What's different: It refuses. When documentation is ambiguous or conflicting, it returns null and flags it instead of inventing a plausible number. Built by a physician, so it knows HAM-D-17 and HAM-D-21 aren't the same scale. Every scale citation verified against PubMed.

records.name: Adverse Media Screening
records.tagline: Contextual Adverse Media For Smarter AML Decisions
records.description: Shufti scans 50,000+ news sources, blogs and social media in real time, catching risk long before an entity reaches a regulatory list. NLP sorts every hit into 410+ risk categories rather than raising a keyword flag, covering financial crime, trafficking, terrorism, cybercrime and violent crime. A 100% exact-name match runs by default, so analysts review real hits not partial ones. Monitoring continues after onboarding, alerting when a cleared customer hits the news, with source links attached.

records.name: Brandligo
records.tagline: Global B2B Directory Listing
records.description: Brandligo is a global B2B directory of companies, the brands they own and the products they ship, with client reviews moderated before publication.

records.name: Lumina
records.tagline: Practice the language conversations you’ll actually have.
records.description: Lumina is an AI language-learning website built around realistic conversations. Practice speaking in 8 languages through AI-powered scenarios like traveling, school, work, restaurants, interviews, and everyday life. Get feedback, build confidence, and practice anytime without needing a conversation partner. Start with a 7-day free trial—no credit card required.

records.name: Finkalc
records.tagline: Client-side, privacy-first financial calculators.
records.description: An ad-free, privacy-focused suite of financial tools. Calculate mortgages, auto loans, and paychecks with 100% client-side data sovereignty. No server-side logs—your financial data stays strictly inside your browser.

records.name: Foundara
records.tagline: Founder events, investors for your startup ,  co-founders
records.description: Foundara is a networking platform for founders, entrepreneurs, developers, marketers, and startup builders. Create a founder profile, showcase your skills and goals, discover investors for your startup, and connect with founders. Unlike general social networks, Foundara is built specifically to help people find co-founders, startup partners, and the right talent needed to turn ideas into real businesses.

records.name: Forkive
records.tagline: Rank restaurants like Letterboxd ranks movies
records.description: Forkive is a restaurant tracker built around ranking, not star ratings. Instead of rating a meal 1-5 stars in isolation, you rank it against restaurants you've already been to, so your list actually reflects how a place compares to everywhere else you eat. Solo project, about 2 months in. Web-first today with dish-level notes, want-to-try lists, and a social feed to see where friends have been. iOS is next. Built it because my notes app was just a graveyard of restaurants I couldn't compare.

records.name: 주소핀
records.tagline: Find Korean website links in one place
records.description: 포털·은행·정부·공공·OTT·쇼핑 등 공식 사이트 226곳의 검증된 공식 홈페이지 주소를 모은 주소모음·링크모음. 공식 도메인을 함께 확인해 피싱 걱정 없이 바로가기하세요. Jusopin is a Korean-language website directory that helps you find commonly used websites in one place. Browse categories including search, shopping, banking, government services, education, and AI tools. Search by website name, read a short introduction, and check the listed domain before visiting. Website: https://jusopin.com/

records.name: TODO Flow
records.tagline: Turn TODOs into parallel agent work, review, and delivery
records.description: Select TODOs and coordinate Claude or Codex agents across isolated Git worktrees. TODO Flow keeps plans, progress, and evidence in project files that survive the chat, with a local dashboard, verification, and independent agent reviews. MIT licensed; uses your existing CLI accounts.

records.name: Markly
records.tagline: A calm, native Markdown editor for your folders
records.description: Markly is a free, open-source Markdown editor for macOS that edits themd files in folders you already have: no import, no database, no lock-in. Formatting renders as you type, and markers hide on lines you're not editing. Native SwiftUI + AppKit with Liquid Glass, no Electron. Format bar on selection, clickable tasks, one-click Git sync, focus mode, scroll-synced preview with math, HTML/PDF export. No accounts, no tracking.

records.name: NexusAXI
records.tagline: Research, plan, create, and automate recurring work
records.description: NexusAXI is an AI platform built for founders who need more than answers. It combines advanced reasoning, image generation, persistent memory, workflow automation, and autonomous scheduled bots in one system. Use Nexus to research, plan, create, automate recurring work, and keep supported tasks moving after the chat ends — with one login, one memory, and one AI running your workflow.

records.name: Kelam
records.tagline: Let your agent make the calls you don't want to
records.description: Your assistant can reach anything with a URL. The locksmith, the clinic and the garage don't have one. Kelam gives an AI assistant a phone number of its own — one it dials out from, and one that answers when it rings. One sentence installs it in Claude, Muse, a coding agent or your terminal.

records.name: Relium
records.tagline: Catch risky dbt changes before they break business metrics
records.description: Relium is a pre-merge reliability layer for SQL and dbt. It reviews every PR, understands semantic changes, traces downstream model and KPI impact, checks warehouse evidence, and returns ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK before production. Unlike observability tools that alert after data breaks, Relium helps teams catch silent logic failures before they ship.

records.name: AgreeGuard
records.tagline: AI reads the fine print before you click "I Agree"
records.description: 91% of people accept terms and conditions without reading them. AgreeGuard is a free Chrome extension that reads the fine print for you. One click, and in under 15 seconds you get a plain-English summary with red flags highlighted auto-renewals, data selling, hidden fees, waived legal rights, and privacy concerns. Works on any website. No account needed.

records.name: Split
records.tagline: Resize connected Mac windows together, with live content
records.description: Split is a macOS menu-bar window manager. Arrange windows, then drag their shared divider to resize both while their contents update live. Click the divider to swap sides. Click a side's window count to open its switcher; click again to cycle through stacked windows. Works with left-right and top-bottom layouts. $4.99 once for one active Mac. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.

records.name: CrbonFree
records.tagline: Audit-grade carbon numbers for every AI token you use
records.description: How much energy and carbon does your AI use? CrbonFree meters every call, per model and per provider, and turns the answer into a report an auditor can check.

records.name: WebDecoy for Vercel
records.tagline: Know which crawlers hit your Vercel app, and which are fake
records.description: Connect a project and WebDecoy reads your Vercel log drain. No code changes. It identifies crawler traffic per request, verifies real crawlers against published IP ranges, and flags forged user agents. Monitoring only: it never blocks, never reports humans.

records.name: Hyperdream
records.tagline: The Cursor of AI filmmaking
records.description: AI filmmaking is fragmented across scripts, characters, visuals, video models, and editing tools. Hyperdream brings the entire workflow into one intelligent AI filmmaking platform. Create from idea to final video while Hyperdream manages context, recommends the right models, maintains consistency, and handles the heavy lifting so creators can focus on storytelling not juggling tools.

records.name: FLYBOX
records.tagline: Explore a fruit-fly connectome inside a living sandbox
records.description: FlyBox is an open-source interactive sandbox built around a simulated fruit-fly connectome with 166,700 neurons and ~25.6M synapses. Give the fly food, predators, obstacles, light and other stimuli, then watch its neural activity and behavior change in real time. Stimulate or silence neural populations, lesion connections, fork experiments, compare brains and inspect what the fly is doing as it happens.

records.name: Pinky Promise
records.tagline: A reminder for the promises you make with friends
records.description: I turned Pinky Promise into a tiny digital contract. Pick something you want to do, make a promise, decorate it, and add a ridiculous penalty if someone bails. It’s intentionally silly, but the commitment is real. A playful alternative to another calendar reminder, designed to turn “we should do that sometime” into “okay, we’re actually doing it.”

records.name: Token Forecaster
records.tagline: Forecast how long an LLM reply will run, before Enter
records.description: Token Forecaster puts a range on an LLM reply before you press Enter: the usual length, and a worst case that held for 90.6% of 4,146 unseen calls. While the reply streams, it shows whether it is running long. It only watches and never changes the request. Learns from your local history. Open source, MIT.

records.name: Online Reputation Management Services
records.tagline: Increase Google Reviews for Your Business
records.description: Protect, repair, & strengthen your digital presence with data-driven online reputation management services. Global coverage. AI-powered strategy. Proven results.

records.name: Dictoterix
records.tagline: Language learning service built around the dichotic method
records.description: Dictoterix is the first online learning service built end-to-end around the bilingual-dichotic method: your native language in one ear, the language you're learning in the other, at the same moment. Most apps teach “words”. The question that matters is which words — so every level in Dictoterix is measured against a reference inventory of what an A1–C1 learner actually needs. No card. No trial clock. It's just free.

records.name: JevForAgents
records.tagline: Explore real Jev agent builds, demos, and patterns
records.description: Explore 360+ curated Jev AI agent builds, open-source code & video demos. Discover Claude Code skills, browser agents & SEO workflows with latenJev for Agents helps developers explore how Jev is used in AI agent workflows. Browse source-linked builds, video demos, repositories, and implementation patterns for browser automation, routing, tool selection, evaluation, and guardrails. Follow an example to its source, then use the guides to try a pattern in your own agent.

records.name: TourKit
records.tagline: Lightweight product tours with a hosted dashboard
records.description: TourKit is a lightweight product tour tool for any website. Most tools are either heavy & expensive (Appcues, Pendo) or pure code libraries with no dashboard (Shepherd, Intro.js). TourKit sits in the middle: → One script tag (React, Next.js, Vue, WordPress, HTML) → Hosted dashboard — edit tours without redeploying → Context-aware steps (works with dynamic URLs) → Clean dark-glass tooltips + basic analytics Pricing: Free · $9 · $19 Note: Paid plans are in demo mode. Free tier is fully working.

records.name: layernote
records.tagline: Visual feedback on websites, Figma files, PDFs and images
records.description: Collect visual feedback on live websites, PDFs and images. Clients pin comments through a share link, no account needed. Keep discussions and tasks in one place, and work through changes yourself or with your team. For website fixes, you can also hand feedback to your coding agent via MCP.

records.name: Aks.ai
records.tagline: Your personal companion for guided self-reflection.
records.description: Aks is a personal companion that helps you talk through what's happening in your life, reflect on your thoughts, and understand yourself better. We built Aks to be a private, judgment-free space for daily guided reflection. Unpack your day, process your feelings, and gain valuable insights into your own mind. Whether you're navigating stress, celebrating wins, or just need to vent, Aks is always here to listen and help you grow.

records.name: RemoteConsole
records.tagline: Reach your home or work terminal when agents can't or won't
records.description: RemoteConsole is a mobile SSH terminal built for developer on the go. Especially for running AI coding agents from your phone. Connect to your own Mac and Linux machines and reattach to the persistent tmux session where Claude Code, Codex, Aider or Gemini CLI is working. Steer it by touch or voice. When the agent stalls or refuses, or the task shouldn't be delegated, you have a real shell right there. You can reach machines behind NAT with no VPN, and an SFTP browser comes built in.

records.name: OutBrick
records.tagline: VoiceOver-ready block puzzle, no clock, free browser board
records.description: OutBrick is a sliding-block puzzle for iPhone and iPad, with a free board you can play in your browser. Colours are paired with glyphs, VoiceOver reads the board, and there is no clock.

records.name: Save for AI
records.tagline: Turn any AI-made work into your next creation
records.description: See an AI-made work you want to build on? Claw it. Turn it into an AI-ready project. Keep creating with AI.Claw a running AI-made work, turn it into an AI-ready project, and keep creating with AI. Save for AI captures current webpage content and assets with offline preview support, allowing curated materials to be used for AI-assisted analysis and secondary creation. Simple and intuitive, it is ideal for archiving, research, and content creation.

records.name: Pikopod
records.tagline: rehearse the failures, reproduce the ones you missed locally
records.description: Third-party API sandboxes are flaky, incomplete, and drift from production without warning. pikopod is an open-source Go CLI that simulates API sandboxes locally and detects drift, flagging when a real API stops matching what your integration expects, before users hit errors. Mocking tools fake responses; pikopod also checks them against the real API. Built from years of maintaining payment integrations. Apache-2.0, installable via Homebrew.

records.name: Umbra
records.tagline: A privacy screen that watches for your attention
records.description: Umbra is a free, open-source privacy screen for Windows. It uses your webcam to notice when you look away and instantly covers your screen; look back and it's gone in 0.15 s. On-device face tracking (MediaPipe) reads head direction and eye gaze, and a one-minute calibration fits it to your desk. Cover with a blur, your own image, a GIF/video or a solid colour. Press F8 to toggle, or pause from the tray. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

records.name: Tarno
