records.name: Cover Culture
records.tagline: Don't judge a book. Buy its cover.
records.description: Why does a book only get one cover? Cover Culture gives books the freedom they deserve. Through print-on-demand technology, artists create and earn royalties on custom editions of books they love, and readers get to own a cover that truly speaks to them. Lets build a cover culture.

records.name: LinkedIn Candidate Search (No Cookies)
records.tagline: Find LinkedIn candidates without sharing your cookie
records.description: Describe the role (title, seniority, stack, cities) and get a shortlist of public LinkedIn profiles. No login, no li_at cookie, no account risk. Sends results to Airtable, Slack, Notion or your ATS. Works as an MCP tool.

records.name: minimo (video)
records.tagline: Compress videos. Not your privacy.
records.description: A free, open-source video compressor for iOS and Android. Shrink videos directly on your device — no uploads, no accounts, no subscriptions. Your videos shouldn't need to leave your phone just to become smaller. minimo is a free, open-source video compressor for iOS and Android that processes everything directly on your device. No uploading a private video to a server. No waiting for it to download again. No account. No subscription.

records.name: PaperBeam: Scanner & PDF
records.tagline: PaperBeam – Private Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit
records.description: PaperBeam is an offline-first document scanner and productivity toolkit built for fast, secure, and private work. Scan, edit, organize, sign, OCR, and share documents directly from your phone—no account or cloud required. Scan receipts, IDs, notes, forms, and more; enhance and redact pages, create PDFs, export to DOCX, scan QR/barcodes, and keep everything organized with folders, tags, and search.

records.name: DokBot
records.tagline: Turn your docs into a support chatbot for your website
records.description: DokBot builds an AI chatbot from your PDFs and text files. It answers questions 24/7 and gets the users email what it can't solve — it never makes up an answer.

records.name: BidToRank
records.tagline: Free product discovery board. List instantly, no approval
records.description: BidToRank is a free product discovery board for founders anywhere. List your SaaS, AI tool, app or creator channel in seconds, with no fees and no approval wait. Listings go live instantly, newest first. Visitors browse by category (SaaS, AI/ML, DevTools, Fintech, E-commerce, Gaming, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram), search, and see trending products ranked by real clicks. Any listing can be shared to X, WhatsApp or LinkedIn in one tap.

records.name: Noxora
records.tagline: Manifest while you sleep
records.description: What if you could fall asleep listening to the life you're becoming? Noxora turns bedtime into a daily practice for your future self. Listen to immersive, spoken sleep affirmations designed for your subconscious, built around the person you want to become - from confidence and success to abundance, self-love, luxury lifestyle and more.

records.name: Enkio
records.tagline: Turn any song into a cinematic AI music video
records.description: Enkio turns any song into a cinematic music video — no editor, no production budget. Upload a track, add a few photos, describe the vibe — the AI syncs visuals to your music and renders a share-ready MV in minutes. What's different: • Music-first: visuals sync to the track's rhythm and mood • Photo-to-video: your own photos star in the MV • Prompt-driven styles: anime to blockbuster trailer • On web, iOS and Android For musicians and creators who want their song to look as good as it sounds.

records.name: Guard Starter
records.tagline: Allow, ask, or deny every MCP tool call
records.description: Guard Starter is the human gate inside SentinelAgent Guard: allow / ask / deny for MCP and agent tool calls across Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, and other MCP hosts. Deterministic policies, no model in the approval path. Deny returns a readable refusal, not a hang; decisions land in an audit log. Starter free: local allow / ask / deny, short audit, 1 seat. Starter Pro: $19/mo, cloud sync and longer audit. Guard Pro $49/mo is a soft upsell, not the PH headline price. Same Guard brand. Same site.

records.name: Bite Insight
records.tagline: Food barcode scanner with personalised insights just for you
records.description: Bite Insight goes beyond the nutrition label. Scan a food barcode and get personalised insights based on your health conditions, allergies and dietary preferences. See what matters to you at a glance, from sugar and GI to sodium, ingredients and allergens - turning confusing food labels into clear, relevant information that helps you make more informed choices.

records.name: Tomtorrent
records.tagline: Torrent android client
records.description: TomTorrent is a production-grade torrent client for Android, built for fast, simple, and reliable downloads. Download torrents and magnet links with a clean, modern interface, track your downloads, and manage transfers with ease. No account required and no unnecessary complexity. Just a focused torrent experience designed for Android.

records.name: Safezone Studio
records.tagline: See what your video looks like before TikTok covers it
records.description: Free browser-based safe zone checker. Drop in your video or thumbnail and preview it against exact TikTok, Reels, Shorts & YouTube UI overlays. No signup, no upload.

records.name: QRfun
records.tagline: Free QR codes that never expire - no signup, no watermark
records.description: Create customizable static QR codes free in your browser, scan/decode QR images, calculate print sizes, and make dynamic QR codes when you need editable destinations and analytics. No signup for static codes, no watermark, and they never expire.

records.name: NameValidator
records.tagline: NameValidator — 4D brand name check in 1s
records.description: Input any brand name → instant 4-dimension report: ⚖️ Trademark similarity (fuzzy match against known brands) 🌐 Domain availability via real WHOIS (.com/.cn/.net/.io/.ai) 📱 Social media handle occupation (5 platforms) 🌍 Cultural risk (homophones, negative connotations) Built with Python + FastAPI. Zero external APIs. Free. No signup. Open source: github.com/TTK795/name-validator

records.name: Creative Canvas
records.tagline: Sketching, painting & Drawing
records.description: Create without limits on a calm, powerful canvas built for iPad. Creative Canvas is a digital art studio for sketching, painting, and illustration. Start a new canvas, pick expressive brushes, and shape every stroke with size, opacity, and color controls that stay out of your way.

records.name: Rank Reactor AI
records.tagline: Your AI Powered Revenue Growth Engine
records.description: RankReactorAI reads your live site and ships on-brand content and UGC videos that rank and convert. The AI SEO growth engine built for businesses that want buyer traffic, not just visitors. Fully automated, set it and forget it, and watch users flock to your website. RankReactorAI also partner with tech blogs and Youtube channels to help you distribute brand awareness.

records.name: MIDIpad
records.tagline: Your gamepad is a musical instrument
records.description: MIDIpad is a macOS application that transforms game controllers into musical instruments compatible with any modern digital audio workstation. More than simply mapping gamepad buttons to MIDI notes or CCs, MIDIpad turns your gamepad into two powerful, accessible, MPE-capable MIDI controllers: Chords, an expressive, scale-aware plucked-string engine, and Drums, a real-time, gesture-driven drum sequencer.

records.name: GitHub statistics · Velocity Radar
records.tagline: Real GitHub momentum, including private repos & AI agents
records.description: Standard GitHub profiles only count green squares. Velocity Radar measures true momentum across public and private repos without exposing private code. Features: • Pace: Compares your last 30 active days to your historical baseline. • Breakdown: Sorts commits into substantive, automated, and merges. • Stamina: Tracks unbroken runs and multi-day solid streaks. Built for high-output developers and AI agent commanders. Add a dynamic radar to your profile.

records.name: DEV·TV
records.tagline: A retro TV for GitHub, HN, Hugging Face & more: 10 channels
records.description: Most devs check GitHub, Hacker News, DEV and Hugging Face out of habit. DEV·TV turns them into 10 live channels that play on their own, like TV. Glance, catch one story, get back to coding. Leave it on an office screen or a remote team's always-on tab and it becomes shared context: everyone sees what's rising, and anyone can point and ask "did you see this?" One HTML file: no backend, no login, no build step. Real source data, built-in reader, no AI summaries. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: cael
records.tagline: Every booking tool. One calendar.
records.description: Tired of sending multiple booking links? cael merges Calendly, Cal.com, and Microsoft Bookings into one timezone-aware calendar you can share or embed. Visitors pick a slot and book on the original tool. We only read availability, never invitee data. Color-coded event types, busy overlays, and auto-sync so you stop juggling calendars.

records.name: Quiz1v1
records.tagline: Free 1v1 Aptitude Quiz Duels & Competitive Exam Practice
records.description: Practice aptitude questions online for placements and competitive exams. Prepare quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability and data interpretation, or challenge someone in a live 1v1 quiz duel. Built for students preparing for placements, competitive exams and anyone who wants a more engaging way to improve their aptitude skills.

records.name: CODE-STORE
records.tagline: Privacy
records.description: ▎ CODE-STORE gives you what a cloud code host does — repositories, branches, ▎ diffs, a web interface — on your own hardware. No account, no telemetry, no ▎ outbound calls. It works as a real git remote. Linux and Windows. £149 once, ▎ no subscription.

records.name: Rinalance
records.tagline: Manual-first money tracking, no bank connection required
records.description: Most finance apps start by asking for your bank login. Rinalance doesn't need one. You enter balances and transactions yourself, so you decide what data exists. Personal, Business, and other accounts stay separate contexts, never blended into one total. Assets, liabilities, debts, subscriptions, and charts across 7 currencies with automatic conversion. Export on both plans. Free plan, no time limit. Premium (€4.99/month) adds budgets, forecasts, and investment performance. No ads.

records.name: Surveywells
records.tagline: Earn Money by Taking Online Surveys
records.description: Welcome to SurveyWells — the easiest way to make money online by sharing your thoughts. We connect you with top global brands that want your opinions on products, services, and trends. In return, you get real rewards, cash, and gift cards — fast and secure.

records.name: Drive
records.tagline: A private, flexible cloud drive for families and teams.
records.description: Drive is a private cloud drive for families and teams. Connect your own Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket and manage files in a modern workspace. Upload, organize, search, preview, share, and recover files while keeping control of your storage. Personal and shared drives, team permissions, family sharing, locked folders, and shared links make Drive a flexible alternative to traditional cloud storage. Launching for people who want cloud convenience without storage lock-in.

records.name: Founder Battle
records.tagline: Turn product activity into ongoing distribution
records.description: Founder Battle helps products get seen through ongoing activity, not a one-time listing. Join the global ladder, challenge the product above you, judge matchups, share results, and get challenged by other founders. Each action brings products back into view, creating new chances for discovery and feedback. Challenges are free, independent Arena Votes decide rank, and paid exposure never buys votes, wins, or position.

records.name: PDFfinch
records.tagline: Merge, split, compress, and sign PDFs. No account.
records.description: PDFfinch is a free set of PDF tools: merge, split, compress, rotate, remove pages, redact, add a password, convert images, extract text, and sign. Most tools run in the browser, so the file you open is not uploaded. There is no account and no watermark. Signature requests and shared download links are stored so the recipient can open them, then deleted after 7 days. A signature records the name entered, the time, and consent. It is for ordinary documents, not a qualified electronic signature.

records.name: WalkFarm
records.tagline: Turn your daily steps into farm energy
records.description: Walk to play. WalkFarm is a relaxed pixel farming game where the steps you already take become energy for your homestead. Clear land, plant seeds, water crops, and harvest them as they grow over a few days. Your steps are counted in the background, and every 100 steps becomes 1 farm energy. Play with friends, earn gifts on 10,000 step days, and unlock new seeds in the gem shop. Your step data stays on your device. It is never sold or used for ads.

records.name: FabFlow
records.tagline: Run the fab. Find the bottleneck. Ship on time.
records.description: FabFlow is a browser game about running a fictional semiconductor factory. Automation already moves the lots. You watch the line, open Decisions when something jams, and live with the trade-off. Start Pilot Line in one click. Orbit the miniature fab, read pressure on the floor, and clear holds, maintenance, and capacity choices before the audit clock runs out. Educational simulation with invented data. Not a real fab, recipe, or manufacturing instruction.

records.name: LUCENT
records.tagline: Turn your app into a professional product video in minutes
records.description: Lucent turns your app or SaaS into polished product videos in minutes. Its AI Agent creates the structure, animated product scenes, marketing copy, voiceover, and visuals for you. Customize everything in Lucent Studio, switch between formats for X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, then export a professional video without a production team.

records.name: LynoraLink
records.tagline: Modern social network with voice & video calls
records.description: LynoraLink is a modern SaaS social networking app designed for professionals and communities. It offers instant messaging, voice and video calls, group creation, and company pages. With bilingual support (English & French) and a sleek UI/UX, LynoraLink helps users connect, grow their network, and advance their careers.

records.name: Report Card - Doomscroll District School
records.tagline: Report cards for your posts by one tired teacher.
records.description: Report Card is the official grade slip of Doomscroll District School, Fall 2026 semester. Accredited by nobody. (We checked.) Enrollment takes one social media handle to grade card. No login, no password, nothing to install. Private accounts are politely turned away at the gate. The teacher reads your recent public posts and grades six subjects. Grades run from A+ (with a gold star sticker) to F (Parents meeting).

records.name: Smart Glasses Atlas
records.tagline: Know what smart glasses actually work before you buy
records.description: Smart Glasses Atlas is an independent comparison and buying-guide site for smart glasses — no sponsorships, no pay-for-ranking. Every claim shows its source and check date. We track real availability across 32 countries and 12 languages, not just US listings, so you know what's actually sold and supported where you live before you spend €300+.

records.name: Video Silence Remover
records.tagline: VideoEditing
records.description: I made Video Silence Remover, a free Android app that auto-detects and cuts dead air from your videos. Sick of manually scrubbing out silent pauses (podcasts, talking-head videos, vlogs)? This does it in seconds: Import video AI detects silence - on-device Preview trimmed result Export & share 100% on-device - video never leaves your phone, no uploads, no data collected. Would love feedback from anyone who edits video regularly!

records.name: Trylle
records.tagline: The AI-powered Git platform for modern software teams
records.description: Trylle is an AI-powered Git platform for the future of software development, where agents and humans ship together. Alongside full GitHub parity (Actions CI, PRs, Issues), we offer AI-native features: automated PR reviews, security audits, and customizable repo automations with the model and harness of your choice. Our latest product, Magic Sessions, runs long-horizon tasks across multiple repos in a VM with Ubuntu or macOS. Powered by Vercel AI Gateway and Vercel Sandboxes across 18 regions.

records.name: Decktly
records.tagline: Edit HTML presentations like PowerPoint
records.description: Decktly is an HTML editor that works like PowerPoint. Open an AI-generated deck, edit text and layouts, add charts and tables, and leave comments. Save your work as HTML. Available on Windows, Mac, and in your browser.

records.name: 14 gentle mornings by Small WIns
records.tagline: Audio first physiotherapy delivered via WhatsApp
records.description: Small Wins is a 14-day audio movement programme delivered to WhatsApp every morning. No app, no login, no equipment, no floor work. Each day: a 30-second personal intro from your coach, a 7-minute guided session (movement, breathing, a food swap), then a quick check-in that shapes tomorrow. Designed by a physiotherapist, enhanced by AI, built for women 55+ who want to feel stronger without the gym.

records.name: Booklern
records.tagline: A bilingual reader for learning English from real books
records.description: Booklern is a bilingual book reader for learning English through real books. Read English with a sentence-by-sentence translation into your language, listen to the text, look up any word instantly, save vocabulary, practise pronunciation, and upload your own EPUB.

records.name: EnovaVPN — Fast, Private, Secure VPN
records.tagline: Fast, borderless privacy built for the modern web.
records.description: EnovaVPN is built to protect your online privacy without sacrificing your browsing speed. With a robust network of high-speed servers worldwide, EnovaVPN secures your data against hackers, ISPs, and trackers. Whether you are working on public Wi-Fi, streaming global content, or securing your smart devices, enjoy unrestricted and anonymous internet access at the click of a button.

records.name: ZEON Solutions AI
records.tagline: AI agents that do the work for small and mid-size businesses
records.description: ZEON Solutions AI is an AI-native platform plus a forward-deployed engineering team. Hive runs AI agents on schedules for reporting, checklists and outreach. Around it: CRM with AI sales alerts, Find Buyers prospecting, Contract Collab drafting, text-to-SQL over BigQuery, an issue tracker and AI recruiting. We embed with your team, map the workflow, and put agents on the repetitive parts, so small businesses get the automation big companies build in-house.

records.name: Aeronexum
records.tagline: The Aviation Operating Platform
records.description: AERONEXUM is an Aviation Operating Platform built to connect the work behind aviation parts and operations. Manage relationships, quoting, sales, purchasing, inventory, serialized and rotable parts, repair, quality, shipping, invoicing, and more in one connected system. Instead of adding more screens and complexity, AERONEXUM is designed to reduce cognitive load, preserve context, and help teams focus on what needs attention next.

records.name: FinalFrame
records.tagline: AI photo critique: what to fix next and when to stop editing
records.description: Other critique tools grade a photo once. FinalFrame scores your edit against the original and tells you when to stop. Upload a photo and in about a minute you get one named problem and the slider values to fix it in Lightroom or Capture One. Upload your next version and see what changed and what is still holding it back. Free plan, 12 languages. Launch month: your first paid month comes with 50% extra credits.

records.name: 1dollarbutton.click — Collect $1,000,000
records.tagline: Press a button. Pay crypto or Telegram Stars.
records.description: One button. One dollar. One million to go. Contribute $1 to $20 — or any custom amount — using crypto (on the web) or Telegram Stars (inside the Mini App). Watch the counter drop from $1,000,000 in real time. No sign-ups. No accounts. Just a button and a crazy idea. Live payment feed. Top supporters leaderboard. RU/EN. Join the experiment.

records.name: StatementLift
records.tagline: Turn bank statement PDFs into private CSVs
records.description: Convert text-based bank and credit-card statement PDFs into clean CSV files for Excel. StatementLift processes everything locally in your browser—no account, no upload, and no server storing your financial document. Built for quick reconciliation, budgeting, bookkeeping, and visa-document preparation.

records.name: CureCoders — Pharma Intelligence
records.tagline: AI multi-agent intelligence for drug discovery & pharma
records.description: CureCoders replaces weeks of manual biopharma research with 7 specialized AI agents. Enter any therapeutic query or upload internal docs (PDF, Excel, PPT) to get real-time market sizing, competitor share-of-voice, clinical trial filtering, patent cliff timelines, and molecule pipelines. Generate boardroom-ready PDF briefs, financial Excel models, and 5-slide executive PPT decks in minutes.

records.name: MenuPhotoLab
records.tagline: Every dish, every delivery app, from your real photos
records.description: Most AI food tools will happily hand you a different dish. MenuPhotoLab is built so it can't. Upload the phone photo of the dish you actually cooked: it fixes light, background and framing, then exports that same photo sized for DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Google and Instagram in one pass. Same portion, same ingredients. Keep your plate or replate it. Non-food uploads are refused. 5 photos free, no card, no watermark, then packs from $13 that never expire.

records.name: Predict-With-Jev
records.tagline: AI
records.description: JEV Terminal is a crypto research workspace powered by TypeSafe JEV. Explore live Kraken markets, compare assets with AI, inspect forecasts, and track their outcomes over time. Built for traders who want to understand the evidence, test new ideas, and make informed decisions while staying in full control.

records.name: CiteWise
records.tagline: Verify academic references with evidence
records.description: CiteWise verifies that academic references are real and correctly matched. It cross-checks bibliographic metadata across scholarly sources, recovers missing DOIs, explains field-level conflicts, and supports single, batch, file-import, and API workflows for researchers, librarians, editors, and research teams.

records.name: Fashion Try-On AI
records.tagline: Turn fabric into outfits and virtually try them on with AI
records.description: Fashion Try-On AI by VISHNEXA turns fabric or clothing images into AI-generated outfit concepts and lets you virtually try them on using a person photo. Explore different fashion styles, visualize garments before making or buying them, save your creations, and prepare outfit details for tailoring. Available on the web and Android.

records.name: Whapter
records.tagline: Your complete social automation
records.description: Whapter brings WhatsApp, Instagram, and AI Voice Agents together in one powerful automation platform. Automate conversations, campaigns, follow-ups, and customer interactions without switching between multiple tools.

records.name: Speedo
records.tagline: Offline GPS speedometer, trip odometer and HUD for Android
records.description: Track speed and trip distance on Android with an offline GPS speedometer, saved routes, mirrored HUD and personal speed alerts. Trip history stays on your phone. Core tracking needs no account. Optional one-time Pro removes ads and adds trip exports.

records.name: M AI

records.description: M AI مساعد ذكي فائق السرعة: يصنع الصور والفيديوهات والألعاب المصغّرة والأكواد والمواقع الكاملة مع معاينة مباشرة وزر نشر، وقابل للتثبيت على هاتفك.

records.description: Wan 3.0 AI Video Generator creates up to 30-second 1080p cinematic videos with native audio from text, images, and multimodal references. Keep characters consistent, control camera movement, and generate sound with the picture — built for ads, social clips, previz, and product storytelling.

records.name: Intraspect
records.tagline: CNC lathe simulator for programming and testing
records.description: See your G-code before the machine does. Intraspect is a free, open-source CNC turning simulator for Siemens SINUMERIK. records.name: NoirHQ: The #1 Tattoo Booking Ecosystem.

records.description: NoirHQ is the #1 booking ecosystem for tattoo studios, better than any generic tool out there. It beats the competition with secure RBAC artist logins, automated deposit collection to kill no-shows, a high-converting exact-date cancellation waitlist, and built-in artwork design approvals. records.name: Lilac Editor
records.tagline: The tiny, framework‑agnostic WYSIWYG editor

records.name: NexusScreen Studio

records.name: ContextBridge
records.tagline: Turn your AI resources into one controlled pool
records.description: ContextBridge turns local models, private machines, VPSes and model APIs into one controlled pool. Apps describe what they need; CB routes jobs to a compatible worker based on capabilities, policy and live capacity. It supports self-hosting, explainable routing, E2EE, schedules, deterministic pipelines, MCP and bounded multi-step workflows, without forcing you onto a single runtime or cloud.

records.name: Chroma Panel - Modern React Color Picker
records.tagline: Modern React color picker for real app workflows
records.description: Chroma Panel is an open-source React color picker for forms, theme editors, design tools, and modern web apps. It includes a color wheel, RGB/HSL sliders, palettes, image color picking, an eyedropper, gradients, OKLCH and Display P3 support, accessibility, TypeScript, and zero runtime dependencies. Start with a simple ColorInput or use the full panel and import only the modes you need.

records.name: ImgKit
records.tagline: 50 Image Tools, Right in Your Browser
records.description: I built ImgKit because I was tired of searching for a different website every time I needed to compress, resize, convert, or edit an image. ImgKit brings 50+ everyday image tools into one place, with processing happening directly in your browser. No uploads, no signup, and many tools work offline.

records.name: Cohezly
records.tagline: Product-ready design system for AI products
records.description: Cohezly is a free Figma design system for building AI products. It includes thoughtfully designed primitives, components, patterns, and examples for creating consistent high quality AI experiences. Use it directly in Figma, or connect it to your coding agent through Figma MCP.

records.name: Huggged
records.tagline: Text hugs, video hugs, real hugs — all in one app
records.description: Most hug apps do one thing — a single tap, a vibration, a notification. Huggged is the first to bring every kind of connection into one place: text, voice, video, and real meetups for when someone needs company, not just a message. It's built as a gift platform, not a creator economy — friends, followers, or even strangers can send appreciation for a birthday, a celebration, or just because, with every core feature free to use.

records.name: habit-tracker
records.tagline: A minimalist habit tracker.
records.description: A minimalist open-source habit tracker built with pure HTML. No installation required, no ads, completely free. Just open it in your browser and start building your habits right away. Android APK download is also available.

records.name: AstraNote
records.tagline: Fast notes. Private when needed. Smarter with AI.
records.description: AstraNote is a fast, browser-first notebook for text you actually need again: snippets, links, instructions, reminders and private notes. Search across devices, share revocable read-only links, use Astra AI with preview-before-save, and choose per-note protection from standard encryption to AstraZero client-generated keys. Free includes 20 notes and 128 KB, with no ads or analytics. Paid plans add organization, stronger privacy and recovery.

records.name: domscout
records.tagline: Turn any webpage into clean Markdown, screenshots & DOM data
records.description: domscout is a serverless browser engine built for AI workflows and agents. Render dynamic JavaScript pages in real Chromium and get clean LLM-ready Markdown, structured DOM data, screenshots, or PDFs in a single call. Use it via REST API or instantly connect our 10 MCP tools to Claude, Cursor, or VS Code. Every request reports exact credit costs and remaining balance. Includes scheduled visual monitors, webhooks, and 100 free requests/mo (no card required).

records.name: Resume AI
records.tagline: Will your resume be ghosted or accepted?
records.description: Upload your resume and get an instant AI-powered prediction of your job success likelihood.

records.name: OKTAN.store

records.description: Cruise Money Saver shares cruise money saving tips, cruise hacks, and cruise budget tips to help you learn how to save money on a cruise. Cruise More. Spend Less.

records.name: InvoiceRocket
records.tagline: Invoices that never become a GST notice, for freelancers
records.description: Built for Indian freelancers and solo studios billing clients at home and abroad. Zoho and ERPs are made for finance teams; a freelancer has no finance team. InvoiceRocket sends GST-compliant invoices in any currency with a UPI QR on the PDF, then audits every invoice, LUT, FIRC and RCM self-invoice against the actual GST and income-tax rules, citing the section and estimating the exposure before a notice does. Reminders, GSTR exports, AI assistant. Free under ₹15L a year.

records.name: KnownSum
records.tagline: Free US tax and money calculators
records.description: Free US tax and money calculators, updated for the 2026 rules. Work out what you owe, what you keep, and what you can claim.

records.name: Sync & Shop — Family Organizer
records.tagline: Your household's lists, calendar, utility bills in one place
records.description: Sync & Shop keeps the shopping list, the calendar, the chores and the conversation in one place for your whole household — updated instantly on every phone.

records.name: Black Node Fitness & Mental Health
records.tagline: Fitness, Recovery & Mental Health Conversations That Matter
records.description: A supportive community for fitness, steroid discussions, recovery, mental health, wellness, and health-related topic.

records.name: Gaming Information Platform | Shree Win
records.tagline: Online Casino Game, Online Gaming, Casino Games,
records.description: Shree Win is an online gaming platform focused on providing information about online casino games, gaming features, and the latest trends in the digital gaming industry. Explore different types of online casino game content, understand game features, and stay updated with the evolving online gaming experience. Shree Win aims to provide a simple and user-friendly platform for visitors interested in online gaming and casino game information.

records.name: Hope Cards
records.tagline: Daily Bible verse cards for a quiet moment of hope
records.description: Build a simple Scripture habit, one card at a time. Hope Cards for Android brings daily Bible verses, shareable verse artwork, gentle reminders, favorites, and a journal linked to each verse. Choose Bible translations, languages, and card themes, with optional peaceful music in Daily Hope. No account needed. Every feature is free, supported by ads, with an optional one-time purchase to remove ads permanently. No subscription.

records.name: Custom Led Sign for Business
records.tagline: Custom Signs, Graphics & Vehicle Wraps for Your Business
records.description: Create a custom LED sign for business with tailored designs, illuminated channel letters, quality materials, professional installation, and signage support.

records.name: WAWebSender
records.tagline: Marketing Automation/CRM/Communication/Sales Enablement
records.description: Start free with WAWebSender, a WhatsApp Bulk Sender for WhatsApp Web. Import Excel contacts, personalize messages, control intervals and export results.

records.name: SALOMI EHS Software
records.tagline: Industrial Safety & Incident Management System
records.description: SALOMI is an advanced EHS management software that streamlines workplace safety, compliance, and risk tracking. Built for safety teams, it unifies incident reporting, inspections, audits, and permits into real-time actionable dashboards. Beyond core EHS, SALOMI supports facility and building management built for KSA regulatory standards, as well as VR training for immersive hazard recognition, helping organizations gain full visibility to address risks proactively.

records.name: Ten Minutes Review
records.tagline: a daily ten-minute quiz from your language lessons
records.description: For language learners: paste your tutor's notes or photograph your notebook, and get a short quiz each morning on the words, phrases, and grammar you studied.

records.name: Easy Spin
records.tagline: Doorstep laundry and dry cleaning, now live in Delhi
records.description: Easy Spin is India's first app-based laundry and dry cleaning marketplace, now live in Delhi. We connect you with verified local service partners for reliable doorstep pickup and delivery, so you can skip the trip and get fresh clothes back on your schedule.

records.name: Best ERP Software
records.tagline: Streamline Business Operations with Smarter Solutions
records.description: Discover a powerful ERP solution in the UAE designed to streamline accounting, inventory, CRM, HR, sales, procurement, asset management, and more. PACT REVENU helps businesses automate daily operations, improve efficiency, gain real-time visibility across departments. Stay compliant UAE VAT and e-invoicing requirements while managing your business from one integrated platform. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, improve decision making, sustainable growth with PACT REVENU. Book a demo today.

records.name: ClipNova
records.tagline: Create viral AI videos with no camera or editing skills
records.description: Create & edit AI videos with ClipNova. Generate viral shorts, ads, avatars and trends, no camera, no editing skills required.

records.name: HelloCounsel.ai
records.tagline: HellocCounsel AI Receptionist + Intake for Law Firms
records.description: HelloCounsel answers inbound calls and makes outbound calls, logs every note in your CMS, so your team can focus on clients, not phones.

records.name: Questionable Sphere
records.tagline: Anonymous World with floating questions
records.description: Questionable Sphere is a place where questions float freely and people can discover conversations they might never have found otherwise.

records.name: Mezaic
records.tagline: Publishing platform for professionals
records.description: Create your website or blog, grow an audience and accept bookings. Bring Mezaic Persona, your AI twin, to your own site and approved external websites. You don't need to use multiple tools to manage your professional presence, your links (link in bio), email lists, blog, customer testimonials, or meetings (via Google Calendar). Mezaic combines all the features that a founder, a creator or a freelancer needs.

records.name: Digital Overload Reset
records.tagline: A ready-to-run micro-learning kit for team focus
records.description: Digital Overload Reset helps HR, L&D teams, and managers run a practical 15–20 minute session on notification overload and focused work. The downloadable kit includes an editable 5-slide deck, an 88-second captioned video, fillable A4 and US Letter worksheets, a facilitator guide, source notes, and a single-entity internal-use license. It is an educational toolkit, not a clinical intervention or productivity guarantee.

records.name: Satco Part #: S23137
records.tagline: Satco Field Selectable LED Corncob Mogul Ext. 277-480V
records.description: The Satco S23137 270/200/135W Field Selectable LED Corncob Mogul Ext. 277-480V is a lamp featuring 270/200/135W Field Selectable LED Corncob Mogul Ext, 277-480V.

records.name: oladoc
records.tagline: Find The Best Doctors in Pakistan
records.description: Pakistan's largest and most trusted digital healthcare platform for booking appointments with top doctors, lab tests, surgeries, and more.

records.name: AHA Kid
records.tagline: 3D stories and early-grade learning in your browser
records.description: Parent-guided 3D stories with read-alouds in 5 languages, plus Grade 1–3 Math, English and Science practice. Try 3 free stories and 9 free learning books. Optional parent account saves progress. More books are paid. Includes AI-assisted content.

records.name: Roomnexa
records.tagline: Cloud Hotel PMS for Modern Hospitality Teams
records.description: Roomnexa is a cloud-based Hotel PMS built to bring essential hotel operations into one platform. Manage reservations, rooms, front desk, housekeeping, billing, payments, restaurant POS, channel management, booking engine and reports from one place. Designed for hotels, resorts, guest houses and growing hospitality businesses, Roomnexa helps teams reduce manual work and manage daily operations with real-time information.

records.name: Sunkit Cash Tracker
records.tagline: Track the daily cost of anything you buy
records.description: Sunkit turns the price of a purchase into its daily cost. Enter what you paid and how long you'll use it — the app tracks daily cost, break-even progress, and milestones. Fully offline: no account, no network, no data collection. Free on the App Store.

records.name: jsontoall.tools
records.tagline: JSON to 20+ formats, 100% in your browser, zero upload
records.description: Free browser-based JSON tools for developers. Convert JSON to YAML, CSV, TypeScript, XML, TOML, C#, Python, Go, and more. Format, validate, diff, and generate mock APIs — no signup, no server uploads.
